title_en: TVDRNet: Text-driven Viewpoint Optimization via Differentiable Rendering for 3D Reasoning Segmentation
title_zh: TVDRNet：经可微渲染的文本驱动视点优化用于 3D 推理分割

sentences.en: Three-dimensional (3D) reasoning segmentation aims at segmenting target objects based on text instructions and 3D spatial cues.
sentences.zh: 三维（3D）推理分割旨在基于文本指令与 3D 空间线索分割目标对象。

sentences.en: Recent efforts in 3D reasoning leverage Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) to bridge the gap between text and 3D data.
sentences.zh: 近期在 3D 推理方面的努力利用多模态大语言模型（MLLM）弥合文本与 3D 数据之间的差距。

sentences.en: However, since MLLMs are primarily trained on text-image pairs, directly adapting them to unstructured 3D point clouds often fails to capture implicit semantic intent and reliably localize objects.
sentences.zh: 然而，由于 MLLM 主要基于文本-图像对训练，直接将它们适配到无结构 3D 点云往往无法捕捉隐式语义意图并可靠定位对象。

sentences.en: This paper introduces TVDRNet to address these challenges.
sentences.zh: 本文引入 TVDRNet 以应对这些挑战。

sentences.en: Inspired by Active Vision theory, where humans selectively choose optimal viewpoints to better observe targets, TVDRNet employs a differentiable renderer to simulate this active process in 3D perception.
sentences.zh: 受主动视觉理论启发（人类选择性地选择最优视点以更好地观察目标），TVDRNet 采用可微渲染器在 3D 感知中模拟这一主动过程。

sentences.en: By using text instructions as supervision to optimize intrinsic and extrinsic rendering parameters, the TVDRNet identifies the optimal viewpoints for observing the 3D scene, and therefore learning 'where to look' based on what the text instruction 'asked to find'.
sentences.zh: 通过用文本指令作为监督来优化内参与外参渲染参数，TVDRNet 识别观察 3D 场景的最优视点，从而基于文本指令“要求找到”的内容学习“看哪里”。

sentences.en: This process generates informative, task-relevant 2D images that are compatible with MLLMs.
sentences.zh: 这一过程生成与 MLLM 兼容的信息丰富、任务相关 2D 图像。

sentences.en: TVDRNet comprises: (1) the AVPL module, establishing a learnable mapping from semantics to optimal rendering parameters; and (2) the MGL module, fusing multi-modalities via semantic grouping to guide mask generation.
sentences.zh: TVDRNet 包括：（1）AVPL 模块，建立从语义到最优渲染参数的可学习映射；以及（2）MGL 模块，通过语义分组融合多模态以引导掩码生成。

sentences.en: Experiments show TVDRNet achieves the state-of-the-art performance in 3D reasoning segmentation (Reason3D, Instruct3D) and 3D visual grounding (ScanRefer) benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 实验表明，TVDRNet 在 3D 推理分割（Reason3D、Instruct3D）与 3D 视觉接地（ScanRefer）基准上取得最先进性能。

title_en: TVI-CoT: Text-Visual Interleaved Chain-of-Thought Reasoning for Multimodal Understanding
title_zh: TVI-CoT：面向多模态理解的文本-视觉交错思维链推理

sentences.en: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has proven effective for enhancing problem-solving in large language models.
sentences.zh: 思维链（CoT）推理已被证明能有效提升大语言模型的问题解决能力。

sentences.en: However, when applied to multimodal LLMs (MLLMs), existing CoT approaches suffer from a fundamental limitation: they perform reasoning entirely in text without accessing visual features during the reasoning process.
sentences.zh: 然而，当应用于多模态 LLM（MLLM）时，现有 CoT 方法存在一个根本局限：它们在推理过程中完全在文本中推理，不访问视觉特征。

sentences.en: After initial visual encoding, image information becomes inaccessible, forcing models to reason based solely on whatever was captured in the initial description, which forms a `vision-blind reasoning' paradigm that limits fine-grained visual extraction, error verification, and adaptive attention.
sentences.zh: 初始视觉编码之后，图像信息变得不可访问，迫使模型仅基于初始描述捕获的内容进行推理，这形成一种“视觉盲推理”范式，限制细粒度视觉提取、误差验证与自适应注意力。

sentences.en: We propose Text-Visual Interleaved Chain-of-Thought (TVI-CoT), a framework that enables explicit interleaving of textual reasoning and visual feature access through learnable control tokens ($\langle\text{Think}\rangle$, $\langle\text{Look}\rangle$, $\langle\text{Answer}\rangle$).
sentences.zh: 我们提出文本-视觉交错思维链（TVI-CoT），一个通过可学习控制词元（$\langle\text{Think}\rangle$、$\langle\text{Look}\rangle$、$\langle\text{Answer}\rangle$）实现文本推理与视觉特征访问显式交错的框架。

sentences.en: These tokens allow dynamic switching between reasoning and visual grounding, attending to relevant image regions conditioned on the evolving reasoning state.
sentences.zh: 这些词元允许在推理与视觉接地之间动态切换，以不断演化的推理状态为条件关注相关图像区域。

sentences.en: Experiments on eight benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art results among MLLM-based CoT methods and notable performance boost compared to the baseline: +6.1\% on MMMU, +3.8\% on MathVerse, +3.4\% on MathVista, and +3.4\% on ScienceQA.
sentences.zh: 在八个基准上的实验表明，在基于 MLLM 的 CoT 方法中取得最先进结果，并相对基线带来显著性能提升：MMMU 上 +6.1\%、MathVerse 上 +3.8\%、MathVista 上 +3.4\%、ScienceQA 上 +3.4\%。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://github.com/hulianyuyy/TVI-CoT.
sentences.zh: 代码见 https://github.com/hulianyuyy/TVI-CoT。

title_en: Twice Sequential Monte Carlo for Tree Search
title_zh: 用于树搜索的两次序贯蒙特卡洛

sentences.en: Model-based reinforcement learning (RL) methods that leverage search are responsible for many milestone breakthroughs in RL.
sentences.zh: 利用搜索的基于模型的强化学习（RL）方法在许多 RL 里程碑式突破中发挥关键作用。

sentences.en: Sequential Monte Carlo (SMC) recently emerged as an alternative to the Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) algorithm which drove these breakthroughs.
sentences.zh: 序贯蒙特卡洛（SMC）近年作为促成这些突破的蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）算法的替代方案而出现。

sentences.en: SMC is easier to parallelize and more suitable to GPU acceleration.
sentences.zh: SMC 更易于并行化，更适合 GPU 加速。

sentences.en: However, it also suffers from large variance and path degeneracy which prevent it from scaling well with increased search depth, i.e., increased sequential compute.
sentences.zh: 然而，它也遭受大方差与路径退化，这阻碍它随搜索深度（即随序贯计算）增加良好扩展。

sentences.en: To address these problems, we introduce Twice Sequential Monte Carlo Tree Search (TSMCTS).
sentences.zh: 为应对这些问题，我们引入两次序贯蒙特卡洛树搜索（TSMCTS）。

sentences.en: Across discrete and continuous environments TSMCTS outperforms the SMC baseline as well as a popular modern version of MCTS as a policy improvement operator, scales favorably with sequential compute, reduces estimator variance and mitigates the effects of path degeneracy while retaining the properties that make SMC natural to parallelize.
sentences.zh: 跨离散与连续环境，TSMCTS 作为策略改进算子在 SMC 基线以及一个流行的现代 MCTS 版本上均取得更优表现，随序贯计算有利扩展，降低估计器方差并缓解路径退化影响，同时保留使 SMC 易于并行化的性质。

title_en: TwinQuant: Learnable Subspace Decomposition for 4-Bit LLM Quantization
title_zh: TwinQuant：面向 4 位 LLM 量化的可学习子空间分解

sentences.en: 4-bit quantization reduces the memory footprint and latency of large language model inference, but its aggressive precision reduction can severely degrade accuracy.
sentences.zh: 4 位量化降低了大语言模型推理的内存占用与延迟，但其激进的精度缩减会严重损害准确率。

sentences.en: Prior methods address this by decomposing each weight matrix into two components (e.g., via singular value decomposition) and quantizing them separately, assigning the bulk of values to a low-precision residual component while handling outliers with a high-precision low-rank component.
sentences.zh: 先前方法通过将每个权重矩阵分解为两个分量（例如经奇异值分解）并分别量化来应对这一点，将大部分数值分配给低精度残差分量，同时用高精度低秩分量处理异常值。

sentences.en: However, such decompositions are designed to minimize the real-valued energy of the residual, rather than the post-quantization error of the residual and low-rank components.
sentences.zh: 然而，这类分解的设计目标是最小化残差的实值能量，而非残差与低秩分量的量化后误差。

sentences.en: We propose TwinQuant, a 4-bit quantization framework that learns quantization-friendly decomposed subspaces and jointly reshapes both the low-rank and residual components.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 TwinQuant，一个 4 位量化框架，它学习适定量化的分解子空间，并联合重塑低秩与残差两个分量。

sentences.en: TwinQuant learns component-specific transformations via a joint optimization over the Stiefel and general linear manifolds, flattening their distributions and reducing dynamic-range imbalance.
sentences.zh: TwinQuant 在 Stiefel 与一般线性流形上经联合优化学习分量特异的变换，展平其分布并降低动态范围失衡。

sentences.en: To enable efficient end-to-end execution, we further design a fused dual-component kernel that pipelines the two-stage low-rank computation on-chip and merges both components with a single epilogue, avoiding intermediate global-memory traffic.
sentences.zh: 为支持高效的端到端执行，我们进一步设计了一个融合双分量内核，它在芯片上流水化两阶段低秩计算，并用单个尾声合并两个分量，避免中间全局内存流量。

sentences.en: Across LLaMA3 and Qwen3 models, TwinQuant preserves near-FP16 accuracy and delivers up to $1.8\times$ end-to-end speedup over an FP16 baseline.
sentences.zh: 跨 LLaMA3 与 Qwen3 模型，TwinQuant 保持接近 FP16 的准确率，并相对 FP16 基线实现最高 $1.8\times$ 端到端加速。

title_en: Twins: Learn to Predict Unified Representations with Focal Loss
title_zh: Twins：用焦点损失学习预测统一表示

sentences.en: Unified multimodal models seek a shared visual token space that supports both multimodal understanding and image generation.
sentences.zh: 统一多模态模型寻求一个同时支持多模态理解与图像生成的共享视觉词元空间。

sentences.en: Discrete methods unify the interface via a shared codebook, whereas continuous pipelines often rely on two disparate representations—semantic features (e.g., ViT) for understanding and low-level latents (e.g., VAE) for synthesis—resulting in mismatched latent spaces.
sentences.zh: 离散方法通过共享码本统一接口，而连续流程往往依赖两种迥异的表示——用于理解的语义特征（例如 ViT）与用于合成的低级潜变量（例如 VAE）——导致不匹配的潜在空间。

sentences.en: We propose Twins, a unified continuous token space formed by channel-wise concatenating ViT and VAE features on the same token grid, so the sequence length is unchanged and attention cost does not increase.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 Twins，一个通过在相同词元网格上通道级拼接 ViT 与 VAE 特征形成的统一连续词元空间，因此序列长度不变且注意力代价不增加。

sentences.en: However, jointly modeling Twins in a Diffusion Transformer exposes a severe \textit{optimization imbalance}: the model fits the ViT component well but struggles to match the VAE latent distribution.
sentences.zh: 然而，在 Diffusion Transformer 中联合建模 Twins 暴露了一个严重的 \textit{优化失衡}：模型能很好拟合 ViT 分量，却难以匹配 VAE 潜在分布。

sentences.en: We trace this imbalance to three sources of heterogeneity: frequency bias, intrinsic dimensionality, and condition-aligned vs condition-independent uncertainty.
sentences.zh: 我们将这一失衡追溯到三个异质性来源：频率偏差、固有维度，以及条件对齐与条件无关的不确定性。

sentences.en: To address it, we adapt a focal regression objective for flow matching that upweights large-error VAE dimensions, better balancing optimization across the ViT and VAE components.
sentences.zh: 为应对它，我们为流匹配适配一个焦点回归目标，它提高大误差 VAE 维度的权重，更好地平衡 ViT 与 VAE 分量间的优化。

sentences.en: On ImageNet, this yields up to $10.57$ gFID gain over naive MSE loss without classifier-free guidance.
sentences.zh: 在 ImageNet 上，这相对朴素 MSE 损失带来最高 $10.57$ gFID 的增益，且无需分类器自由引导。

sentences.en: Twins also performs competitively on multimodal understanding benchmarks and improves reconstruction fidelity, narrowing the gap between understanding- and generation-oriented representations.
sentences.zh: Twins 在多模态理解基准上也表现有竞争力，并改进重建保真度，缩小了面向理解与面向生成表示之间的差距。

title_en: TwinWeaver: An LLM-Based Foundation Model Framework for Pan-Cancer Digital Twins
title_zh: TwinWeaver：面向泛癌数字孪生的基于 LLM 的基础模型框架

sentences.en: Precision oncology requires forecasting clinical events and trajectories, yet modeling sparse, multi-modal clinical time series remains a critical challenge.
sentences.zh: 精准肿瘤学需要预测临床事件与轨迹，然而对稀疏、多模态临床时间序列建模仍是一个关键挑战。

sentences.en: We introduce TwinWeaver, an open-source framework that serializes longitudinal patient histories into text, enabling unified event prediction as well as forecasting with large language models, and use it to build Genie Digital Twin (GDT) on 93,054 patients across 20 cancer types.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 TwinWeaver，一个将纵向患者史序列化为文本的开源框架，实现了带大语言模型的统一事件预测与预测，并用于在跨越 20 种癌症类型的 93,054 名患者上构建 Genie 数字孪生（GDT）。

sentences.en: In benchmarks, GDT significantly reduces forecasting errors, achieving a median Mean Absolute Scaled Error (MASE) of 0.87 compared to 0.97 for the strongest time-series baseline ($p<0.001$).
sentences.zh: 在基准测试中，GDT 显著降低预测误差，取得 0.87 的中位数平均绝对缩放误差（MASE），而最强时间序列基线为 0.97（$p<0.001$）。

sentences.en: Furthermore, GDT improves risk stratification, achieving an average concordance index (C-index) of 0.703 across survival, progression, and therapy switching tasks, surpassing the best baseline of 0.662. GDT also generalizes to out-of-distribution clinical trials, matching trained baselines at zero-shot and surpassing them with fine-tuning, achieving a median MASE of 0.75–0.88 and outperforming the strongest baseline in event prediction with an average C-index of 0.672 versus 0.648. Finally, TwinWeaver enables an interpretable clinical reasoning extension, providing a scalable and transparent foundation for longitudinal clinical modeling.
sentences.zh: 此外，GDT 改进了风险分层，在生存、进展与治疗切换任务上取得 0.703 的平均一致性指数（C-index），超越最优基线 0.662。GDT 还泛化到分布外临床试验，在零样本下匹配训练基线并在微调后超越它们，取得 0.75–0.88 的中位数 MASE，并在事件预测中以 0.672 对 0.648 的平均 C-index 超越最强基线。最后，TwinWeaver 实现了一个可解释的临床推理扩展，为纵向临床建模提供了可扩展且透明的基础。

title_en: TWLA: Achieving Ternary Weights and Low-Bit Activations for LLMs via Post-Training Quantization
title_zh: TWLA：经训练后量化实现 LLM 的三元权重与低位激活

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) exhibit exceptional general language processing capabilities, but their memory and compute costs hinder deployment.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）展现卓越的通用语言处理能力，但其内存与计算成本阻碍部署。

sentences.en: Ternarization has emerged as a promising compression technique, offering significant reductions in model size and inference complexity.
sentences.zh: 三值化已成为一种有前景的压缩技术，显著减少模型规模与推理复杂度。

sentences.en: However, existing methods struggle with heavy-tailed activation distributions and therefore keep activations in high precision, fundamentally limiting end-to-end inference acceleration.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法在重尾激活分布上挣扎，因此将激活保持在高精度，从根本上限制了端到端推理加速。

sentences.en: To overcome this limitation, we propose **TWLA**, a post-training quantization (PTQ) framework that achieves 1.58-bit weight compression and 4-bit activation quantization while maintaining high accuracy.
sentences.zh: 为克服这一局限，我们提出 **TWLA**，一个在保持高准确率的同时实现 1.58 位权重压缩与 4 位激活量化的训练后量化（PTQ）框架。

sentences.en: TWLA comprises three components: (1) Euclidean-to-Manifold Asymmetric Ternary Quantizer (E2M-ATQ) minimizes layer-output error under weight ternarization via a two-stage optimization from Euclidean initialization to manifold relocation;
sentences.zh: TWLA 由三个组件构成：（1）欧氏到流形非对称三元量化器（E2M-ATQ），通过从欧氏初始化到流形重定位的两阶段优化，在权重三值化下最小化层输出误差；

sentences.en: (2) Kronecker Orthogonal Tri-Modal Shaping (KOTMS) applies a Kronecker-structured orthogonal rotation to reshape weights into ternary-friendly tri-modal distributions, while the shared rotation statistically suppresses activation outliers; and (3) Inter-Layer Aware Activation Mixed Precision (ILA-AMP) explicitly introduces adjacent-layer second-order interaction costs in bit allocation and jointly optimizes for the layer-wise disparity of activation quantization gains induced by the shared orthogonal transform, preventing cascades triggered by a few weak layers.
sentences.zh: （2）Kronecker 正交三模态整形（KOTMS）应用 Kronecker 结构正交旋转，将权重重塑为适合三值的三模态分布，同时共享旋转在统计上抑制激活异常值；以及（3）跨层感知激活混合精度（ILA-AMP）在位分配中显式引入相邻层二阶交互代价，并联合优化共享正交变换诱导的激活量化增益的层间差异，防止少数弱层触发的级联。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that TWLA is a PTQ method that maintains high accuracy under the **W1.58A4** configuration, while delivering significant inference acceleration.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，TWLA 是一种在 **W1.58A4** 配置下保持高准确率、同时带来显著推理加速的 PTQ 方法。

sentences.en: The code is available at [TWLA](https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/TWLA).
sentences.zh: 代码见 [TWLA](https://github.com/Kishon-zzx/TWLA)。

title_en: Two Calm Ends and the Wild Middle: A Geometric Picture of Memorization in Diffusion Models
title_zh: 两端平静与中间狂野：扩散模型中记忆的几何图景

sentences.en: Diffusion models generate high-quality samples but can also memorize training data, raising serious privacy concerns.
sentences.zh: 扩散模型生成高质量样本，但也可能记忆训练数据，引发严重的隐私担忧。

sentences.en: Understanding the mechanisms governing when memorization versus generalization occurs remains an active area of research.
sentences.zh: 理解管制何时发生记忆与何时发生泛化的机制仍是一个活跃研究领域。

sentences.en: In particular, it is unclear where along the noise schedule memorization is induced, how data geometry influences it, and how phenomena at different noise scales interact.
sentences.zh: 尤其，尚不清楚记忆沿噪声调度在何处被诱导、数据几何如何影响它，以及不同噪声尺度下的现象如何相互作用。

sentences.en: We introduce a geometric framework that partitions the noise schedule into three regimes based on the coverage properties of training data by Gaussian shells and the concentration behavior of the posterior, which we argue are two fundamental objects governing memorization and generalization in diffusion models.
sentences.zh: 我们引入一个几何框架，它基于高斯壳对训练数据的覆盖性质与后验的集中行为，将噪声调度划分为三个区制，我们认为这两个基本对象管理扩散模型中的记忆与泛化。

sentences.en: This perspective reveals that memorization risk is highly non-uniform across noise levels.
sentences.zh: 这一视角揭示记忆风险在噪声水平上是高度非均匀的。

sentences.en: We further identify a danger zone at medium noise levels where memorization is most pronounced.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步识别出中等噪声水平处的一个危险区，其中记忆最为显著。

sentences.en: In contrast, both the small and large noise regimes resist memorization, but through fundamentally different mechanisms: small noise avoids memorization due to limited training coverage, while large noise exhibits low posterior concentration and admits a provably near linear Gaussian denoising behavior.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，小噪声与大噪声区制都抵抗记忆，但通过根本不同的机制：小噪声因训练覆盖有限而避免记忆，而大噪声表现出低后验集中性并允许可证明地近似线性的高斯去噪行为。

sentences.en: For the medium noise regime, we identify geometric conditions through which we propose a geometry-informed targeted intervention that mitigates memorization.
sentences.zh: 对于中等噪声区制，我们识别几何条件，并由此提出一个几何知情的针对性干预以缓解记忆。

title_en: Two Modalities Are Better Than One: Efficient Adversarial Purification via Multimodal Diffusion Models
title_zh: 两种模态优于一种：经多模态扩散模型的高效对抗净化

sentences.en: Adversarial purification uses generative models to restore clean data distributions from unseen attacks without retraining classifiers.
sentences.zh: 对抗净化使用生成模型在无需重训分类器的情况下，从未见攻击恢复干净数据分布。

sentences.en: However, unimodal diffusion-based approaches struggle to preserve semantic consistency, while recent multimodal variants rely on computationally expensive adversarial training or distillation.
sentences.zh: 然而，单模态基于扩散的方法难以保持语义一致性，而近来的多模态变体依赖计算昂贵的对抗训练或蒸馏。

sentences.en: Both approaches often lack theoretical guarantees.
sentences.zh: 两种方法往往缺乏理论保证。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose MultiDAP, a novel framework leveraging multimodal diffusion models for efficient adversarial purification.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出 MultiDAP，一个利用多模态扩散模型进行高效对抗净化的新颖框架。

sentences.en: MultiDAP first learns continuous class-agnostic prompts from clean data to capture rich semantic priors, replacing rigid hand-crafted templates.
sentences.zh: MultiDAP 首先从干净数据学习连续、类别无关的提示以捕获丰富语义先验，取代僵硬的手工模板。

sentences.en: Guided by these prompts, MultiDAP purifies adversarial inputs by minimizing a regularized DDPM loss for only a few steps (e.g., 5-20).
sentences.zh: 在这些提示的引导下，MultiDAP 通过仅几步（例如 5-20）最小化正则化 DDPM 损失来净化对抗输入。

sentences.en: We provide theoretical guarantees for both the likelihood improvement via prompt learning and the convergence of the purification process.
sentences.zh: 我们为经提示学习的似然改进与净化过程的收敛两方面提供理论保证。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and ImageNet-1K demonstrate that MultiDAP matches the robustness of state-of-the-art baselines but with improved efficiency.
sentences.zh: 在 CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100 与 ImageNet-1K 上的大量实验表明，MultiDAP 匹配最先进基线的鲁棒性，但效率更高。

authors.name: Chao Li
authors.institution: RIKEN Center for Advanced Intelligence Project

title_en: Two-dimensional quantization for geometry-aware audio coding
title_zh: 面向几何感知音频编码的二维量化

sentences.en: Recent neural audio codecs have achieved impressive reconstruction quality, typically relying on quantization methods such as Residual Vector Quantization (RVQ), Vector Quantization (VQ) and Finite Scalar Quantization (FSQ).
sentences.zh: 近来的神经音频编解码器已实现令人印象深刻的重建质量，通常依赖残余向量量化（RVQ）、向量量化（VQ）与有限标量量化（FSQ）等量化方法。

sentences.en: However, these quantization techniques limit the geometric structure of the latent space, make it harder to capture correlations between features leading to inefficiency in representation learning, codebook utilization and token rate.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些量化技术限制了潜在空间的几何结构，使捕捉特征间的相关性更难，导致表示学习、码本利用与词元速率方面的低效。

sentences.en: In this paper we introduce Two-Dimensional Quantization (Q2D2), a quantization scheme in which feature pairs are projected onto structured 2D grids, such as hexagonal, rhombic, or rectangular tiling and quantized to the nearest grid values, yielding an implicit codebook defined by the product of grid levels, with codebook sizes comparable to conventional methods.
sentences.zh: 本文引入二维量化（Q2D2），一种量化方案，其中特征对投影到结构化 2D 网格（如六边形、菱形或矩形平铺）上并量化到最近网格值，产生由网格层级乘积定义的隐式码本，码本规模与常规方法相当。

sentences.en: Despite its simple geometric formulation, Q2D2 improves audio compression efficiency, with low token rates and high codebook utilization while maintaining state of the art reconstruction quality.
sentences.zh: 尽管其几何表述简单，Q2D2 提升了音频压缩效率，在保持最先进重建质量的同时实现低词元速率与高码本利用率。

sentences.en: Specifically, Q2D2 achieves competitive to superior performance in various objective and subjective reconstruction metrics, across extensive experiments in speech, audio and music domains compared to state of the art models.
sentences.zh: 具体地，在语音、音频与音乐领域的广泛实验中，Q2D2 相对最先进模型在各类客观与主观重建指标上取得有竞争力乃至更优的性能。

sentences.en: Comprehensive ablation studies further confirm the effectiveness of our design choices.
sentences.zh: 全面的消融研究进一步证实了我们设计选择的有效性。

authors.name: Tal Shuster
authors.institution: Ben Gurion University of the Negev

title_en: Two-Layer Linear Auto-Regressive Models Estimate Latent States
title_zh: 两层线性自回归模型估计隐状态

sentences.en: Auto-regressive models have emerged as powerful tools for sequential data, from language to video.
sentences.zh: 自回归模型已成为从语言到视频的序列数据的强有力工具。

sentences.en: Understanding how and why these models learn latent representations remains an open theoretical question.
sentences.zh: 理解这些模型如何及为何学习潜在表示仍是一个开放的理论问题。

sentences.en: In this work, we demonstrate that when trained by empirical risk minimization on data from partially observed linear dynamical systems,  two-layer linear auto-regressive models naturally learn to approximate Kalman filtering.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们表明，当在来自部分观测线性动力系统的数据上通过经验风险最小化训练时，两层线性自回归模型天然学会近似 Kalman 滤波。

sentences.en: In particular, we show that the learned hidden representation coincides, up to a similarity transformation, with the state estimates produced by the optimal (Kalman) filter, even though the model has no explicit knowledge of the underlying dynamics or state.
sentences.zh: 尤其，我们表明习得的隐表示与最优（Kalman）滤波器产生的状态估计一致（相差一个相似变换），尽管模型对底层动力学或状态没有显式知识。

sentences.en: The result follows from three main insights.
sentences.zh: 该结果源自三个主要洞见。

sentences.en: First, we establish that the Kalman filter is well approximated by an auto-regressive model with bounded truncation error.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们确立 Kalman 滤波可以被带受限截断误差的自回归模型良好近似。

sentences.en: Second, we show that despite non-convexity, the two-layer optimization landscape is benign, i.e., all stationary points are either strict saddles or global minima.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们表明尽管非凸，两层优化景观是良性的，即所有驻点要么是严格鞍点要么是全局极小点。

sentences.en: Finally, as our main contributions, we provide finite-sample guarantees on prediction error, parameter estimation error, and latent state recovery.
sentences.zh: 最后，作为我们的主要贡献，我们提供预测误差、参数估计误差与隐状态恢复方面的有限样本保证。

sentences.en: Numerical simulations support the theoretical results and demonstrate that the latent representations of auto-regressive models recover state estimates.
sentences.zh: 数值模拟支持理论结果，并表明自回归模型的潜在表示能恢复状态估计。

authors.name: Leo Maynard-Zhang
authors.institution: Department of Computer Science, University of Washington

title_en: Two-Parameter Flows for Learning Population Dynamics of Physical Systems
title_zh: 用于学习物理系统群体动力学的双参数流

sentences.en: This work addresses the problem of learning the dynamics of high-dimensional probability densities over time using unlabeled samples, without assuming access to trajectory information.
sentences.zh: 这项工作解决在不假设轨迹信息可用的情况下，用无标签样本学习高维概率密度随时间动力学的问题。

sentences.en: We introduce two-parameter flows that learn only sampling-time transports from a base distribution to each marginal and then extract a physics-time velocity by regressing on coupled synthetic trajectories.
sentences.zh: 我们引入双参数流，它们仅弥补从基分布到每个边际的采样时传输，然后通过对耦合合成轨迹回归提取物理时速度。

sentences.en: We prove that the resulting physics-time dynamics are unique and inherit regularity from the sampling-time transports.
sentences.zh: 我们证明所得物理时动力学是唯一的，并继承采样时传输的正则性。

sentences.en: Because we can build on standard, well-developed conditional flow matching techniques for learning the base-to-marginal transports, our approach scales to high dimensions and avoids per-step optimal-transport couplings, while allowing admissible non-gradient dynamics that can naturally explain rotational or circulating physics phenomena.
sentences.zh: 因为我们可以在成熟、发展良好的条件流匹配技术上构建基准到边际的传输学习，我们的方法可扩展到高维度并避免逐步最优传输耦合，同时允许可解释旋转或环流物理现象的可容许非梯度动力学。

title_en: Two-Stage Unit Tying for Simplifying Differentiable Logic Gate Networks
title_zh: 用于简化可微逻辑门网络的两阶段单元绑定

sentences.en: Differentiable logic gate networks map directly to gate-level circuits, enabling ultra-low-latency inference, yet their logic footprint often exceeds FPGA capacity budgets.
sentences.zh: 可微逻辑门网络直接映射到门级电路，实现超低延迟推理，但其逻辑占用往往超出 FPGA 容量预算。

sentences.en: Tightly fitting a trained model to a target FPGA requires a post-training mechanism to trade off network complexity and accuracy—analogous to pruning in standard neural networks.
sentences.zh: 将训练好的模型紧密适配到目标 FPGA 需要一个训练后机制，在网络复杂度与准确率之间权衡——类似于标准神经网络中的剪枝。

sentences.en: To this end, we introduce *unit tying*: a simplification that forces selected gates to constants (0 or 1), enabling constant propagation and downstream logic elimination.
sentences.zh: 为此，我们引入*单元绑定*：一种将选中门强制为常数（0 或 1）、从而启用常量传播与下游逻辑消除的简化。

sentences.en: However, we observe that naively extending pruning criteria to logic networks is unreliable under such near-discrete modifications.
sentences.zh: 然而，我们观察到在这种近二值修改下，将剪枝准则朴素地扩展到逻辑网络不可靠。

sentences.en: We therefore propose a two-stage algorithm for unit tying: (i) a fast Gauss–Newton screening step under a teacher-referenced logit-distortion objective that constructs a high-recall overshoot set and (ii) a refinement step that corrects approximation and interaction-driven errors using a small number of finite-difference evaluations.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们提出一个两阶段单元绑定算法：（i）在教师参考的 logit 失真目标下提供一个快速 Gauss–Newton 筛选步骤，构造一个高召回过集合；以及（ii）一个用少量有限差分评估修正近似与交互驱动误差的细化步骤。

sentences.en: On CIFAR-10 and MNIST, our method consistently improves the accuracy–area trade-off over common saliency baselines, yielding substantial post-synthesis LUT reductions of up to 48% on CIFAR-10 and 43% on MNIST, with modest accuracy degradation.
sentences.zh: 在 CIFAR-10 与 MNIST 上，我们的方法相对常见显著性基线一致改进准确率-面积权衡，在 CIFAR-10 上实现最高 48%、在 MNIST 上最高 43% 的合成后 LUT 大幅缩减，且准确率退化有限。

title_en: U$^3$CF: Unbiased, Unconfounding, and Unified Causal Framework for Multi-Target Domain Adaptation
title_zh: U$^3$CF：面向多目标域适应的无偏、无混淆与统一因果框架

sentences.en: Multi-target domain adaptation (MTDA) trains a model using a labeled source domain and several unlabeled target domains, aiming to enhance performance across all targets.
sentences.zh: 多目标域适应（MTDA）用带标签的源域与若干无标签目标域训练模型，旨在提升所有目标上的性能。

sentences.en: However, existing methods lack a principled causal formulation and often rely on empirical domain-invariance enforcement, which can bias adaptation across targets.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有方法缺乏有原则的因果表述，往往依赖经验的域不变性强制，这可能使跨目标的适应产生偏差。

sentences.en: To fill this gap, we propose the **U**nbiased, **U**nconfounding, and **U**nified **C**ausal **F**ramework (**U$^3$CF**) for MTDA.
sentences.zh: 为填补这一空白，我们提出面向 MTDA 的 **U**nbiased、**U**nconfounding 与 **U**nified **C**ausal **F**ramework（**U$^3$CF**）。

sentences.en: To *unify* the alignment of multiple domains, we propose a prototype-driven alignment strategy that progressively updates prototypes by high-confidence target predictions, while the contrastive optimization objective jointly aligns target samples to semantic prototypes and preserves class discrimination.
sentences.zh: 为*统一*多个域的对齐，我们提出一个原型驱动对齐策略，它通过高置信目标预测渐进更新原型，而对比优化目标联合将目标样本对齐到语义原型并保持类判别。

sentences.en: By formulating a structural causal model, we reveal that domain-invariant causal factors and domain-specific factors shape representations and labels, while the latter induce spurious label correlations across targets.
sentences.zh: 通过表述一个结构因果模型，我们揭示域不变因果因子与域特异因子塑造表示与标签，而后者在目标间诱导虚假标签关联。

sentences.en: Accordingly, U$^3$CF achieves *unbiased* prediction by disentangling representations into invariant causal components and domain-specific confounders and applying conditional intervention to *block confounding* effects while preserving invariant semantics.
sentences.zh: 相应地，U$^3$CF 通过将表示解缠为不变因果分量与域特异混淆因子，并应用条件干预*阻断混淆*效应同时保持不变语义，实现*无偏*预测。

sentences.en: To ensure precise disentanglement, we leverage mutual information theory to derive a principled criterion for feature separation.
sentences.zh: 为确保精确解缠，我们利用互信息理论推导特征分离的有原则准则。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments on four benchmarks demonstrate that U$^3$CF consistently outperforms leading methods.
sentences.zh: 在四个基准上的大量实验表明，U$^3$CF 一致优于领先方法。

authors.name: Wenxu Wang
authors.institution: Faculty of Information Science and Engineering, Ocean University of China

title_en: U-Cast: A Surprisingly Simple and Efficient Frontier Probabilistic AI Weather Forecaster
title_zh: U-Cast：一个出奇简单而高效的前沿概率 AI 天气预报器

sentences.en: AI-based weather forecasting now rivals traditional physics-based ensembles, but state-of-the-art (SOTA) models rely on specialized architectures and massive computational budgets, creating a high barrier to entry.
sentences.zh: 基于 AI 的天气预报现已与传统基于物理的集合相抗衡，但最先进（SOTA）模型依赖专用架构与庞大计算预算，造成很高的进入门槛。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that such complexity is unnecessary for frontier performance.
sentences.zh: 我们证明这种复杂度对前沿性能并无必要。

sentences.en: We introduce U-Cast, a probabilistic forecaster built on a standard U-Net backbone trained with a simple recipe: deterministic pre-training on Mean Absolute Error followed by short probabilistic fine-tuning on the Continuous Ranked Probability Score (CRPS) using Monte Carlo Dropout for stochasticity.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 U-Cast，一个构建在标准 U-Net 骨干上、以简单配方训练的概率预报器：先对平均绝对误差进行确定性预训练，然后用 Monte Carlo Dropout 提供随机性，对连续排名概率分数（CRPS）进行短期概率微调。

sentences.en: As a result, our model matches or exceeds the probabilistic skill of GenCast and IFS ENS at $1.5^\circ$ resolution while reducing training compute by over $10\times$ compared to leading CRPS-based models and inference latency by over $10\times$ compared to diffusion-based models.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们的模型在 $1.5^\circ$ 分辨率下匹配或超越 GenCast 与 IFS ENS 的概率技能，同时相对领先的基于 CRPS 的模型将训练计算减少超过 $10\times$，相对基于扩散的模型将推理延迟减少超过 $10\times$。

sentences.en: U-Cast trains in under 12 H200 GPU-days and generates a 15-day ensemble forecast in 3 seconds.
sentences.zh: U-Cast 在 12 H200 GPU 天之内完成训练，并在 3 秒内生成 15 天的集合预报。

sentences.en: These results suggest that scalable, general-purpose architectures paired with efficient training curricula can match complex domain-specific designs at a fraction of the cost, opening the training of frontier probabilistic weather models to the broader community.
sentences.zh: 这些结果表明，可扩展的通用架构配合高效训练课程，能以一小部分成本匹配复杂的领域特异设计，将前沿概率天气模型的训练开放给更广泛的社区。

title_en: UAV$^2$: A Unified and Adaptive Scheduling Framework for UAV Autopilot System with Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: UAV$^2$：带强化学习的统一自适应无人机自动驾驶系统调度框架

sentences.en: Unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) autopilot systems typically comprise navigation and flight-control modules, and their effective scheduling is critical to achieving high flight performance.
sentences.zh: 无人机（UAV）自动驾驶系统通常包含导航与飞控模块，它们的有效调度对实现高飞行性能至关重要。

sentences.en: However, most existing UAV platforms adopt a split architecture in which navigation and flight control are deployed on separate hardware devices.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有 UAV 平台采用将导航与飞控部署在不同硬件设备上的分离架构。

sentences.en: This separation restricts system-wide observability and prevents holistic scheduling and optimization across the entire autopilot pipeline.
sentences.zh: 这种分离限制了系统级可观测性，阻碍了跨整个自动驾驶流程的整体调度与优化。

sentences.en: Moreover, autonomous flight performance emerges from implicit, cross-coupled, and accumulated interactions among multiple factors, rendering traditional model-based or heuristic scheduling approaches ineffective.
sentences.zh: 此外，自主飞行性能源自多种因素之间隐式、交叉耦合且累积的相互作用，使传统的基于模型或启发式调度方法失效。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose UAV$^2$, a unified and adaptive scheduling framework for UAV autopilot systems with reinforcement learning, targeting flight performance optimization.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出 UAV$^2$，一个面向 UAV 自动驾驶系统、带强化学习的统一自适应调度框架，以飞行性能优化为目标。

sentences.en: UAV$^2$ integrates navigation and flight control onto a single onboard computing platform and operating system, formulates the scheduling problem as a partially observable Markov decision process, and learns scheduling policies from runtime execution feedback.
sentences.zh: UAV$^2$ 将导航与飞控集成到单一机载计算平台与操作系统上，将调度问题表述为部分可观测马尔可夫决策过程，并从运行执行反馈中学习调度策略。

sentences.en: The proposed approach is trained and evaluated in a hardware-in-the-loop simulation environment.
sentences.zh: 所提方法在硬件在环仿真环境中训练与评估。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that the learned scheduling policy consistently outperforms fixed-rate scheduling strategies in terms of flight robustness and tracking performance.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，习得的调度策略在飞行鲁棒性与跟踪性能方面一致优于固定速率调度策略。

title_en: UB-SMoE: Universally Balanced Sparse Mixture-of-Experts for Resource-adaptive Federated Fine-tuning of Foundation Models
title_zh: UB-SMoE：面向基础模型资源自适应联邦微调的通用均衡稀疏专家混合

sentences.en: Heterogeneous LoRA-rank methods address system heterogeneity in federated fine-tuning of foundation models by assigning client-specific ranks based on computational capabilities.
sentences.zh: 异构 LoRA 秩方法通过根据计算能力分配客户端特异的秩，来应对基础模型联邦微调中的系统异构性。

sentences.en: However, these methods achieve only marginal computational savings, as dense feed-forward computations dominate.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法只实现边际计算节省，因为稠密前馈计算占主导。

sentences.en: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) provides a promising alternative through conditional computation, yet we identify that its naive application to heterogeneous federated settings introduces two critical discordances: (i) expert utilization imbalance and (ii) non-differentiability of Top-K routing.
sentences.zh: 稀疏专家混合（SMoE）通过条件计算提供了一个有前景的替代，但我们识别出将其朴素应用于异构联邦设定会引入两个关键的失调：（i）专家利用率不均衡，以及（ii）Top-K 路由不可微。

sentences.en: Our convergence analysis demonstrates that these discordances lead to degraded convergence, particularly for resource-constrained clients.
sentences.zh: 我们的收敛分析表明，这些失调导致收敛退化，尤其对资源受限客户端。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose Universally Balanced Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (UB-SMoE), which introduces Dynamic Modulated Routing (DMR) to rebalance expert utilization, and Universal Pseudo-Gradient (PG) to reconstruct learning signals for non-activated experts.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出通用均衡稀疏专家混合（UB-SMoE），它引入动态调制路由（DMR）以重新平衡专家利用率，以及通用伪梯度（PG）以重建非激活专家的学习信号。

sentences.en: These mechanisms form a self-reinforcing cycle that maintains expert viability across heterogeneous clients.
sentences.zh: 这些机制形成一个自我强化的循环，在异构客户端间维持专家可行性。

sentences.en: Experiments on benchmarks show that UB-SMoE achieves up to $45.0\%$ computational reduction on low-resource clients while improving their performance by $8.7 \times$ compared to existing heterogeneous LoRA-rank methods.
sentences.zh: 在基准上的实验表明，UB-SMoE 在低资源客户端上实现最高 $45.0\%$ 的计算减少，同时相对现有异构 LoRA 秩方法将其性能提升 $8.7 \times$。

title_en: Ubiquity of Emergent Hebbian Dynamics in Regularized Learning
title_zh: 正则化学习中涌现 Hebbian 动力学的普遍性

sentences.en: Hebbian and anti-Hebbian plasticity are widely observed in the brain and are classically modeled as mechanistic, local homosynaptic rules stabilized by homeostatic constraints.
sentences.zh: Hebbian 与反-Hebbian 可塑性在大脑中被广泛观测到，并被经典地建模为由稳态约束稳定的机制性、局部同突触规则。

sentences.en: This raises an identifiability question: does observing Hebbian/anti-Hebbian structure in synaptic updates uniquely imply an underlying Hebbian computation?
sentences.zh: 这引发一个可识别性问题：在突触更新中观测到 Hebbian/反-Hebbian 结构，是否唯一地意味着底层的 Hebbian 计算？

sentences.en: We identify an alternative, emergent route.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出一条替代性的涌现路线。

sentences.en: We show that near stationarity, L2 weight decay generically drives the \emph{learning-signal} component of many update rules to align with a Hebbian direction, with alignment increasing monotonically with decay strength.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，在近稳态下，L2 权重衰减一般性地驱使许多更新规则的\emph{学习信号}分量与 Hebbian 方向对齐，且对齐度随衰减强度单调增加。

sentences.en: This Hebbian-like signature is not specific to SGD and can arise even for non-learning or random update rules long before learning has ceased.
sentences.zh: 这种 Hebbian 式特征并非 SGD 特有，甚至在训练早已结束之前就可能出现在非学习或随机更新规则中。

sentences.en: We further show that stochastic noise in the learning signal can induce anti-Hebbian alignment, yielding a simple tradeoff with weight decay and a phase boundary in regression settings.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步表明，学习信号中的随机噪声可以诱导反-Hebbian 对齐，在回归设定中产生与权重衰减的简单权衡和一个相边界。

sentences.en: These mechanisms do not replace standard Hebbian theory; they can coexist with genuine Hebbian plasticity and complicate the interpretation of synaptic measurements, motivating experiments that distinguish mechanistic Hebbian computation from emergent Hebbian signatures.
sentences.zh: 这些机制并不取代标准 Hebbian 理论；它们可以与真正的 Hebbian 可塑性共存，并使突触测量的解释复杂化，从而激励区分机制性 Hebbian 计算与涌现 Hebbian 特征的实验。

title_en: UCB Exploration for Fixed-Budget Bayesian Best Arm Identification
title_zh: 固定预算贝叶斯最优臂识别的 UCB 探索

sentences.en: We study best-arm identification (BAI) in the fixed-budget setting.
sentences.zh: 我们研究固定预算设定下的最优臂识别（BAI）。

sentences.en: Adaptive allocations based on upper confidence bounds (UCBs), such as UCBE, are known to work well in BAI.
sentences.zh: 基于上置信界（UCB）的自适应分配（例如 UCBE）已知在 BAI 中表现良好。

sentences.en: However, it is well-known that its optimal regret is theoretically dependent on instances, which we show to be an artifact in many fixed-budget BAI problems.
sentences.zh: 然而，众所周知，其最优遗憾在理论上依赖于实例，我们表明在许多固定预算 BAI 问题中这只是一个伪影。

sentences.en: In this paper we propose an UCB exploration algorithm that is both theoretically and empirically efficient for the fixed budget BAI problem under a Bayesian setting.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出一个在贝叶斯设定下对固定预算 BAI 问题在理论与经验两方面都高效的 UCB 探索算法。

sentences.en: The key idea is to learn prior information, which can enhance the performance of UCB-based BAI algorithm as it has done in the cumulative regret minimization problem.
sentences.zh: 关键思想是学习先验信息，这可以像在累积遗憾最小化问题中那样增强基于 UCB 的 BAI 算法的性能。

sentences.en:
We establish bounds on the failure
probability and the simple regret for the Bayesian BAI problem, providing upper bounds of order $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{K/n})$, up to logarithmic factors, where $n$ represents the budget and $K$ denotes the number of arms.
sentences.zh: 我们为贝叶斯 BAI 问题建立失败概率与简单遗憾的界，提供阶为 $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{K/n})$ 的上界（直至对数因子），其中 $n$ 表示预算，$K$ 表示臂数。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we demonstrate through empirical results that our approach consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们通过经验结果表明，我们的方法一致优于最先进基线。

title_en: UCPO: Uncertainty-Aware Policy Optimization
title_zh: UCPO：不确定性感知策略优化

sentences.en: The key to building trustworthy large language models (LLMs) lies in endowing them with inherent uncertainty expression capabilities, thereby mitigating overconfident errors in high-stakes applications.
sentences.zh: 构建可信的大语言模型（LLM）的关键在于赋予它们固有的不确定性表达能力，从而在高风险应用中减轻过度自信的错误。

sentences.en: However, existing RL paradigms such as GRPO often suffer from Advantage Bias due to binary decision spaces and static uncertainty rewards, inducing either excessive conservatism or overconfidence.
sentences.zh: 然而，诸如 GRPO 等现有 RL 范式因二值决策空间与静态不确定性奖励而常常遭受优势偏差，诱发过度保守或过度自信。

sentences.en: To tackle this challenge, this paper unveils the root causes of reward hacking and overconfidence in current RL paradigms incorporating uncertainty-based rewards, based on which we propose the **U**n**C**ertainty-Aware **P**olicy **O**ptimization (**UCPO**) framework.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，本文揭示了当前纳入基于不确定性奖励的 RL 范式中奖励黑客与过度自信的根本原因，并据此提出 **U**n**C**ertainty-Aware **P**olicy **O**ptimization（**UCPO**，不确定性感知策略优化）框架。

sentences.en: UCPO employs Ternary Advantage Decoupling to separate and independently normalize deterministic and uncertain rollouts, thereby eliminating advantage bias.
sentences.zh: UCPO 采用三元优势解耦，分离并独立归一化确定性与不确定回滚，从而消除优势偏差。

sentences.en: Furthermore, a Dynamic Uncertainty Reward Adjustment mechanism adapts uncertainty weights in real-time according to model evolution and instance difficulty.
sentences.zh: 此外，动态不确定性奖励调整机制根据模型演化与实例难度实时调整不确定性权重。

sentences.en: Experimental results in mathematical reasoning and general tasks demonstrate that UCPO effectively resolves the reward imbalance, significantly improving the reliability of the model beyond their knowledge boundaries.
sentences.zh: 在数学推理与一般任务中的实验结果表明，UCPO 有效解决了奖励失衡，显著提升模型超出知识边界的可靠性。

sentences.en: The code is available at https://github.com/xzhouzeng/ucpo.
sentences.zh: 代码见 https://github.com/xzhouzeng/ucpo。

title_en: UDM-GRPO: Stable and Efficient Group Relative Policy Optimization for Uniform Discrete Diffusion Models
title_zh: UDM-GRPO：面向均匀离散扩散模型的稳定高效组相对策略优化

sentences.en: Uniform Discrete Diffusion (UDM) has recently emerged as a promising paradigm for discrete generative modeling; however, its integration with reinforcement learning remains largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 均匀离散扩散（UDM）近年作为离散生成建模的一种有前景范式出现；然而，它与强化学习的整合在很大程度上仍未得到探索。

sentences.en: We observe that naively adapting GRPO to UDM leads to unstable training and marginal performance.
sentences.zh: 我们观察到，将 GRPO 朴素适配到 UDM 会导致训练不稳定与性能有限。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose \Ours, the first framework that integrates UDM with RL.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出 \Ours，第一个将 UDM 与 RL 整合的框架。

sentences.en: Our method is guided by two key insights: (i) treating the final clean sample, rather than intermediate predicted sample, as the action provides more accurate and stable optimization signals; and (ii) adopting the forward process to reconstruct the training trajectories helps the model learn probability paths that are more consistent with pretraining.
sentences.zh: 我们的方法由两个关键洞见引导：（i）将最终干净样本（而非中间预测样本）视为动作，提供更准确、更稳定的优化信号；以及（ii）采用前向过程重建训练轨迹，帮助模型学习与预训练更一致的概率路径。

sentences.en: For efficiency, we introduce Reduction-Step and CFG-Free training strategies.
sentences.zh: 为提高效率，我们引入缩减步与免 CFG 训练策略。

sentences.en: \Ours significantly improves the performance of the base model across multiple T2I tasks.
sentences.zh: \Ours 在多个 T2I 任务上显著改进基座模型的性能。

sentences.en: Notably, GenEval accuracy improves from $69\%$ to $96\%$ and PickScore increases from $20.46$ to $23.81$, achieving state-of-the-art performance in both continuous and discrete settings.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，GenEval 准确率从 $69\%$ 提升到 $96\%$，PickScore 从 $20.46$ 提升到 $23.81$，在连续与离散设定中都取得最先进性能。

sentences.en: On the OCR benchmark, accuracy improves from $4\%$ to $57\%$, further validating the effectiveness and generalization capability of our method.
sentences.zh: 在 OCR 基准上，准确率从 $4\%$ 提升到 $57\%$，进一步验证了我们方法的有效性与泛化能力。

title_en: UFO: Chain-of-Evaluation for Omni-Condition Alignment in Multi-Modal Image Generation
title_zh: UFO：面向多模态图像生成中全条件对齐的评估链

sentences.en: Multi-modal image generation, particularly subject-driven customization, has garnered growing attention in recent years.
sentences.zh: 多模态图像生成，尤其主体驱动定制，近年受到越来越多的关注。

sentences.en: Despite the rapid advancement of generative models, their evaluation remains largely lagging.
sentences.zh: 尽管生成模型快速进步，它们的评估在很大程度上仍落后。

sentences.en: Existing methods, whether embedding-based or Multi-modal Large Language Model (MLLM)-based, evaluate alignment with each modal condition in isolation, which contradicts the simultaneous condition alignment objective of multi-modal image generation, leading to poor consistency with human judgments.
sentences.zh: 现有方法，无论基于嵌入还是基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM），都孤立地评估与每个模态条件的对齐，这与多模态图像生成的同步条件对齐目标相矛盾，导致与人类判断的一致性不佳。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose \textbf{UFO}, the first \textbf{U}ni\textbf{F}ied framework for \textbf{O}mni-condition alignment simultaneous evaluation.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出 \textbf{UFO}，第一个面向全条件对齐同步评估的 **U**ni**F**ied（统一）**O**mni（全）框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, UFO introduces a novel Atomized Chain-of-Evaluation paradigm, \emph{i.e.}, it first decomposes omni-condition alignment into a sequential chain of fine-grained, disentangled Atomic Evaluation Units (AEUs), categorizes them into distinct modality-relevance classes, and then employs general or dedicated functional calls for accurate verification of different AEU types.
sentences.zh: 具体地，UFO 引入一种新颖的原子化评估链范式，\emph{即}，它首先将全条件对齐分解为细粒度、解缠的原子评估单元（AEU）序贯链，将它们分类为不同的模态相关性类别，然后用通用或专门的函数调用来准确验证不同类型的 AEU。

sentences.en: Experimental results demonstrate that UFO achieves the highest correlation with human evaluation preferences, delivering an average improvement of 15.25\%.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，UFO 与人类评估偏好达到最高相关性，平均改进 15.25\%。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we present UFO-Bench, a dedicated benchmark designed to holistically evaluate the performance of existing customization models under the diverse mutual interactions of textual and visual conditions.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们提出 UFO-Bench，一个专用基准，旨在文本与视觉条件多样相互作用的场景下，全面评估现有定制模型的性能。

title_en: UGround: Towards Unified Visual Grounding with Unrolled Transformers
title_zh: UGround：用展开 Transformer 迈向统一视觉接地

sentences.en: We present UGround, a **U**nified visual **Ground**ing paradigm that dynamically selects intermediate layers across **U**nrolled transformers as "mask as prompt,'' diverging from the prevailing pipeline that leverages the fixed last hidden layer as "$\langle\texttt{SEG}\rangle$ as prompt.'' UGround addresses two primary challenges posed by the prevailing paradigm: (1) its reliance on the fixed last hidden layer, which sequentially amplifies cumulative errors arising from layer-by-layer propagation without intermediate correction, and (2) its use of $\langle\texttt{SEG}\rangle$ as a prompt, which implicitly projects textual embeddings into visual space without explicit spatial cues (e.g., coordinates).
sentences.zh: 我们提出 UGround，一个**U**nified visual **Ground**ing（统一视觉接地）范式，它在**U**nrolled（展开）Transformer 上动态选择中间层作为“掩码即提示”，区别于利用固定最后一隐藏层作为“$\langle\texttt{SEG}\rangle$ 即提示”的通行流程。UGround 应对通行范式提出的两个主要挑战：（1）它依赖固定最后一隐藏层，这会在无中间校正的情况下逐层传播，序列化放大累积误差；以及（2）它用 $\langle\texttt{SEG}\rangle$ 作为提示，这在没有显式空间线索（例如坐标）的情况下隐式将文本嵌入投影到视觉空间。

sentences.en: Central to UGround is Policy-Prompted Masking, which comprises two key components: Stochastic Skip Connection (SSC) and Mask as Prompt (MasP).
sentences.zh: UGround 的核心是策略提示掩码，它包含两个关键组成部分：随机跳跃连接（SSC）与掩码即提示（MasP）。

sentences.en: SSC is a reinforcement learning policy that, via stochastic sampling, allows each $\langle\texttt{SEG}\rangle$ token to slide across unrolled transformer layers, enabling dynamic layer selection at which it connects to the vision model (e.g., SAM) in a skip-connection fashion.
sentences.zh: SSC 是一个强化学习策略，它通过随机采样，让每个 $\langle\texttt{SEG}\rangle$ 词元在展开 Transformer 层间滑动，实现它以跳跃连接方式连接到视觉模型（例如 SAM）的动态层选择。

sentences.en: Given the selected hidden layer, MasP uses the similarity map derived from the $\langle\texttt{SEG}\rangle$ token and image tokens as a soft logit mask to prompt SAM for mask generation, offering explicit spatial cues through its activation regions.
sentences.zh: 给定选定的隐藏层，MasP 用由 $\langle\texttt{SEG}\rangle$ 词元与图像词元导出的相似图为 SAM 提供软 logit 掩码以生成掩码，通过其激活区域提供显式空间线索。

sentences.en: To validate the effectiveness of UGround, we, for the first time, have unified visual grounding within a single framework from an attribute perspective, spanning from traditional refer expression segmentation to newly proposed reasoning segmentation, single-target to multi-target, positive query to false premise (empty target).
sentences.zh: 为验证 UGround 的有效性，我们首次从属性视角将视觉接地统一到一个框架中，涵盖从传统指代表达式分割到新提出的推理分割、单目标到多目标、正向查询到虚假前提（空目标）。

sentences.en: All codes are provided in the supplementary material.
sentences.zh: 所有代码见补充材料。

title_en: UHR-BAT: Budget-Aware Token Compression Vision-Language model for Ultra-High-Resolution Remote Sensing
title_zh: UHR-BAT：面向超高分辨率遥感、预算感知的词元压缩视觉-语言模型

sentences.en: Ultra-high-resolution (UHR) remote sensing imagery couples kilometer-scale context with query-critical evidence that may occupy only a few pixels.
sentences.zh: 超高分辨率（UHR）遥感图像将公里级上下文与可能只占数像素的查询关键证据耦合在一起。

sentences.en: Such vast spatial scale leads to a quadratic explosion of visual tokens and hinders the extraction of information from small objects.
sentences.zh: 如此广阔的空间尺度导致视觉词元的二次方爆炸，并阻碍从细小物体提取信息。

sentences.en: Previous works utilize direct downsampling, dense tiling, or global top‑K pruning, which either compromise query-critical image details or incur unpredictable compute.
sentences.zh: 先前工作采用直接下采样、稠密平铺或全局 top-K 剪枝，它们要么损害查询关键的图像细节，要么招致不可预测的计算。

sentences.en: In this paper, we propose UHR-BAT, a query-guided and region-faithful token compression framework to efficiently select visual tokens under strict context budget.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们提出 UHR-BAT，一个查询引导且区域忠实的词元压缩框架，在严格上下文预算下高效选择视觉词元。

sentences.en: Specifically, we leverage text-guided, multi-scale importance estimation for visual tokens, effectively tackling the challenge of achieving precise yet low-cost feature extraction.
sentences.zh: 具体地，我们利用文本引导、多尺度的视觉词元重要性估计，有效应对实现精确且低成本特征提取的挑战。

sentences.en: Furthermore, by introducing region-wise preserve and merge strategies, we mitigate visual token redundancy, further driving down the computational budget.
sentences.zh: 此外，通过引入区域级保留与合并策略，我们缓解视觉词元冗余，进一步压低计算预算。

sentences.en: The experimental results show that UHR-BAT achieves state-of-the-art performance across various benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 实验结果表明，UHR-BAT 跨多个基准取得最先进性能。

title_en: UI2Code^N: UI-to-Code Generation as Interactive Visual Optimization
title_zh: UI2Code$^N$：将 UI 到代码生成视作交互式视觉优化

sentences.en: UI-to-code aims to translate UI screenshots into executable front-end code.
sentences.zh: UI 到代码旨在将 UI 截图翻译为可执行的前端代码。

sentences.en: Despite progress with vision-language models (VLMs), most existing methods formulate UI-to-code as a single-pass generation, which mismatches real-world UI development that is inherently iterative and feedback-driven.
sentences.zh: 尽管视觉-语言模型（VLM）取得了进展，大多数现有方法将 UI 到代码表述为单次生成，这与本质上迭代、反馈驱动的真实世界 UI 开发不匹配。

sentences.en: We reformulate UI-to-code as an interactive visual optimization problem, where code generation is embedded in a closed-loop process of execution, visual inspection, and iterative refinement driven by rendered visual feedback.
sentences.zh: 我们将 UI 到代码重新表述为一个交互式视觉优化问题，其中代码生成嵌入到由渲染视觉反馈驱动的执行、视觉检查与迭代细化的闭环过程中。

sentences.en: To address the non-differentiability of visual objectives and the noise of absolute visual evaluators, we propose Relative Visual Policy Optimization (RVPO), a preference-based reinforcement learning method that optimizes relative visual rankings among rendered candidates under execution feedback.
sentences.zh: 为应对视觉目标的不可微性与绝对视觉评估器的噪声，我们提出相对视觉策略优化（RVPO），一种基于偏好的强化学习方法，它在执行反馈下优化渲染候选之间的相对视觉排序。

sentences.en: We instantiate this paradigm in UI2Code$^{\text{N}}$, an open-source 9B model trained via continual pre-training, supervised fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning.
sentences.zh: 我们在 UI2Code$^{\text{N}}$ 中实例化这一范式，这是一个经持续预训练、监督微调与强化学习训练的开源 9B 模型。

sentences.en: Experiments demonstrate state-of-the-art performance on UI drafting, UI polishing, and UI editing benchmarks, even outperforming larger models, with performance consistently improving through iterative visual optimization.
sentences.zh: 实验在 UI 草拟、UI 打磨与 UI 编辑基准上展示了最先进性能，甚至超越规模更大的模型，且性能通过迭代视觉优化持续改进。

sentences.en: Our code and models are available at \url{https://github.com/zai-org/UI2Code_N}.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码与模型见 \url{https://github.com/zai-org/UI2Code_N}。

title_en: Ultrafast On-Chip Online Learning via Spline Locality in Kolmogorov–Arnold Networks
title_zh: 经 Kolmogorov–Arnold 网络中样条局部性实现超快片上在线学习

sentences.en: Ultrafast online learning is essential for high-frequency systems, such as controls for quantum computing and nuclear fusion, where adaptation must occur on sub-microsecond timescales.
sentences.zh: 超快在线学习对量子计算与核聚变控制等高频系统至关重要，在这些系统中适应必须在亚微秒时间尺度内发生。

sentences.en: Meeting these requirements demands low-latency, fixed-precision computation under strict memory constraints, a regime in which conventional Multi-Layer Perceptrons (MLPs) are both inefficient and numerically unstable.
sentences.zh: 满足这些要求需要严格内存约束下的低延迟、固定精度计算，这是一个常规多层感知机（MLP）既低效又数值不稳定的体制。

sentences.en: We identify key properties of Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) that align with these constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出与这些约束一致的 Kolmogorov–Arnold 网络（KAN）的关键性质。

sentences.en: Specifically, we show that: (i) KAN updates exploiting B-spline locality are sparse, enabling superior on-chip resource scaling, and (ii) KANs are inherently robust to fixed-point quantization.
sentences.zh: 具体地，我们表明：（i）利用 B 样条局部性的 KAN 更新是稀疏的，实现优越的片上资源扩展；以及（ii）KAN 对定点量化固有鲁棒。

sentences.en: By implementing fixed-point online training on Field-Programmable Gate Arrays (FPGAs), a representative platform for on-chip computation, we demonstrate that KAN-based online learners are significantly more efficient and expressive than MLPs across a range of low-latency and resource-constrained tasks.
sentences.zh: 通过在现场可编程门阵列（FPGA）上实现定点在线训练（片上计算的一个代表性平台），我们表明基于 KAN 的在线学习器在低延迟与资源受限任务上显著比 MLP 更高效且更有表达力。

sentences.en: To our knowledge, this work is the first to demonstrate model-free online learning at sub-microsecond latencies.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这项工作首次展示了亚微秒延迟下的免模型在线学习。

title_en: UltraHorizon: Benchmarking LLM-Agent Capabilities in Ultra Long-Horizon Scenarios
title_zh: UltraHorizon：在超长视界场景中基准测试 LLM 智能体能力

sentences.en: Autonomous agents have recently achieved remarkable progress across diverse domains, yet most evaluations focus on short-horizon, fully observable tasks.
sentences.zh: 自主智能体近年在多样领域取得显著进展，但大多数评估聚焦短期、完全可观测的任务。

sentences.en: In contrast, many critical real-world tasks, such as large-scale software development, commercial investment, and scientific discovery, unfold in long-horizon and partially observable scenarios where success hinges on sustained reasoning, planning, memory management, and tool use.
sentences.zh: 相比之下，许多关键的真实世界任务（例如大规模软件开发、商业投资与科学发现）在长视界与部分可观测场景中展开，其成功依赖于持续的推理、规划、记忆管理与工具使用。

sentences.en: Existing benchmarks rarely capture these long-horizon challenges, leaving a gap in systematic evaluation.
sentences.zh: 现有基准很少捕捉这些长视界挑战，在系统评估上留下空白。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we introduce $\textbf{UltraHorizon}$, a novel benchmark that measures the foundational capabilities essential for complex real-world challenges.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一空白，我们引入 $\textbf{UltraHorizon}$，一个衡量复杂真实世界挑战所必需基础能力的新颖基准。

sentences.en: We use exploration as a unifying task across three distinct environments to validate these core competencies.
sentences.zh: 我们用探索作为三个不同环境中的统一任务来验证这些核心能力。

sentences.en: Agents are designed in long-horizon discovery tasks where they must iteratively uncover hidden rules through sustained reasoning, planning, memory and tools management, and interaction with environments.
sentences.zh: 智能体被设计于长视界发现任务中，它们必须通过持续推理、规划、记忆与工具管理以及与环境交互，迭代地揭示隐藏规则。

sentences.en: Under the heaviest scale setting, trajectories average $\textbf{200k+}$ tokens and $\textbf{400+}$ tool calls, whereas in standard configurations they still exceed $\textbf{35k}$ tokens and involve more than $\textbf{60}$ tool calls on average.
sentences.zh: 在最重的规模设定下，轨迹平均为 $\textbf{200k+}$ 词元与 $\textbf{400+}$ 次工具调用，而在标准配置中它们仍平均超过 $\textbf{35k}$ 词元并涉及超过 $\textbf{60}$ 次工具调用。

sentences.en: Our extensive experiments reveal that agents powered by state-of-the-art LLMs consistently underperform in these settings, whereas human participants achieve much higher scores, underscoring a persistent gap in agents' long-horizon exploration abilities.
sentences.zh: 我们的大量实验揭示，由最先进 LLM 驱动的智能体在这些设定中一致表现不佳，而人类参与者取得高得多的分数，凸显智能体长视界探索能力上持续存在的差距。

sentences.en: We also observe that simple scaling fails in our task.
sentences.zh: 我们还观察到简单的扩展在我们的任务中失效。

sentences.en: To better illustrate the failure of agents, we conduct an in-depth analysis of collected trajectories.
sentences.zh: 为更好地说明智能体的失败，我们对收集的轨迹进行深入分析。

sentences.en: We identify eight types of errors and attribute them to two primary causes: in-context locking and functional fundamental capability gaps.
sentences.zh: 我们识别出八类错误，并将其归因于两个主要原因：上下文锁定与功能基础能力差距。

title_en: UltraLIF: Fully Differentiable Spiking Neural Networks via Ultradiscretization and Max-Plus Algebra
title_zh: UltraLIF：经超离散化与 Max-Plus 代数的完全可微脉冲神经网络

sentences.en: Spiking Neural Networks (SNNs) offer energy-efficient, biologically plausible computation but suffer from non-differentiable spike generation, necessitating reliance on heuristic surrogate gradients.
sentences.zh: 脉冲神经网络（SNN）提供能效高、生物上合理的计算，但遭受不可微的脉冲生成，不得不依赖启发式代理梯度。

sentences.en: This paper introduces **UltraLIF**, a principled framework that replaces surrogate gradients with \emph{ultradiscretization}, a mathematical formalism from tropical geometry providing continuous relaxations of discrete dynamics.
sentences.zh: 本文引入 **UltraLIF**，一个以\emph{超离散化}替代代理梯度的有原则框架，超离散化是来自热带几何的一种数学形式，为离散动力学提供连续松弛。

sentences.en: The central insight is that the max-plus semiring underlying ultradiscretization naturally models neural threshold dynamics: the log-sum-exp function serves as a differentiable soft-maximum that converges to hard thresholding as a learnable temperature parameter $\varepsilon \to 0$.
sentences.zh: 核心洞见是，超离散化背后的 max-plus 半环天然为神经阈值动力学建模：log-sum-exp 函数充当可微软最大值，在可学习温度参数 $\varepsilon \to 0$ 时收敛到硬阈值化。

sentences.en: Two neuron models are derived from distinct dynamical systems: UltraLIF from the LIF ordinary differential equation (temporal dynamics) and UltraDLIF from the diffusion equation modeling gap junction coupling across neuronal populations (spatial dynamics).
sentences.zh: 从不同动力系统导出两种神经元模型：UltraLIF 来自 LIF 常微分方程（时间动力学），UltraDLIF 来自为跨神经元种群的间隙连接耦合建模的扩散方程（空间动力学）。

sentences.en: Both yield fully differentiable SNNs trainable via standard backpropagation with no forward-backward mismatch.
sentences.zh: 两者都产生完全可微的 SNN，可通过标准反向传播训练，且无前向-后向不匹配。

sentences.en: Theoretical analysis establishes pointwise convergence to tropical LIF dynamics with quantitative error bounds and bounded non-vanishing gradients.
sentences.zh: 理论分析确立了到热带 LIF 动力学的逐点收敛，带定量误差界与有界非消失梯度。

sentences.en: Experiments on six benchmarks spanning static images, neuromorphic vision, and audio demonstrate improvements over surrogate gradient baselines, with gains most pronounced in the ultra-low latency regime ($T{=}1$) on neuromorphic and temporal datasets.
sentences.zh: 在覆盖静态图像、神经形态视觉与音频的六个基准上的实验表明，相对代理梯度基线有所改进，其中增益在神经形态与时间数据集上的超低延迟体制（$T{=}1$）中最为显著。

sentences.en: An optional sparsity penalty enables significant energy reduction while maintaining competitive accuracy.
sentences.zh: 一个可选稀疏性惩罚使得在保持有竞争力准确率的同时实现显著节能。

title_en: UMEM: Unified Memory Extraction and Management Framework for Generalizable Memory
title_zh: UMEM：面向可泛化记忆的统一记忆提取与管理框架

sentences.en: Self-evolving memory serves as the trainable parameters for Large Language Models (LLMs)-based agents, where extraction (distilling insights from experience) and management (updating the memory bank) must be tightly coordinated.
sentences.zh: 自演化记忆充当基于大语言模型（LLM）的智能体的可训练参数，其中提取（从经验中蒸馏洞见）与管理（更新记忆库）必须紧密协调。

sentences.en: Existing methods predominantly optimize memory management while treating memory extraction as a static process, resulting in poor generalization, where agents accumulate instance-specific noise rather than robust memories.
sentences.zh: 现有方法主要优化记忆管理，而将记忆提取视为静态过程，导致泛化不佳，智能体累积实例特异的噪声而非鲁棒记忆。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose Unified Memory Extraction and Management (UMEM), a self-evolving agent framework that jointly optimizes a LLM to simultaneously extract and manage memories.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出统一记忆提取与管理（UMEM），一个联合优化 LLM 以同时提取与管理记忆的自演化智能体框架。

sentences.en: To mitigate overfitting to specific instances, we introduce Semantic Neighborhood Modeling and optimize the model with a neighborhood-level marginal utility reward via GRPO.
sentences.zh: 为缓解对特定实例的过拟合，我们引入语义邻域建模，并通过 GRPO 用邻域级边际效用奖励优化模型。

sentences.en: This approach ensures memory generalizability by evaluating memory utility across clusters of semantically related queries.
sentences.zh: 这一方法通过跨语义相关查询簇评估记忆效用，确保记忆可泛化性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across five benchmarks demonstrate that UMEM significantly outperforms highly competitive baselines, achieving up to 11.49 points improvement in multi-turn interactive tasks.
sentences.zh: 跨五个基准的大量实验表明，UMEM 显著优于极具竞争力的基线，在多轮交互任务中实现最高 11.49 分的改进。

sentences.en: Furthermore, UMEM maintains a stable improvement trend during continuous evolution.
sentences.zh: 此外，UMEM 在持续演化期间保持稳定的改进趋势。

title_en: Unbiased Alignment for Large Language Models with Noisy Preferences
title_zh: 带噪声偏好的大语言模型无偏对齐

sentences.en: The alignment of large language models with human preferences is commonly achieved through Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback or Direct Preference Optimization.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型与人类偏好的对齐通常通过基于人类反馈的强化学习或直接偏好优化实现。

sentences.en: However, these methods are vulnerable to the significant noise prevalent in real-world preference datasets.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些方法容易受到真实世界偏好数据集中普遍存在的显著噪声影响。

sentences.en: To address this critical issue, we present a theoretical framework for unbiased alignment, introducing the *Unbiased Reward Model* (URM) loss and the *Unbiased Direct Preference Optimization* (UDPO) loss.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一关键问题，我们提出一个无偏对齐的理论框架，引入*无偏奖励模型*（URM）损失与*无偏直接偏好优化*（UDPO）损失。

sentences.en: By mathematically correcting the distortion induced by preference noise, our novel objectives enable unbiased model training directly from noisy datasets, without requiring clean ground-truth supervision.
sentences.zh: 通过在数学上修正偏好噪声诱导的失真，我们的新颖目标使得能直接从带噪数据集中无偏训练模型，而无需干净真值监督。

sentences.en: We provide rigorous theoretical analyses demonstrating that our methods are noise-tolerant, parameter downward compatible, and classification-calibrated.
sentences.zh: 我们提供严谨的理论分析，表明我们的方法具有噪声容忍、参数向下兼容且分类校准。

sentences.en: Comprehensive experiments across diverse datasets demonstrate that our approaches outperform state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 跨多样数据集的综合实验表明，我们的方法优于最先进基线。

sentences.en: Code available at: https://github.com/cswjl/unbiased-alignment.
sentences.zh: 代码见：https://github.com/cswjl/unbiased-alignment。

title_en: Unbiased and Second-Order-Free Training for High-Dimensional PDEs
title_zh: 面向高维偏微分方程的无偏且免二阶的训练

sentences.en: Deep learning methods based on backward stochastic differential equations (BSDEs) have emerged as competitive alternatives to physics-informed neural networks (PINNs) for solving high-dimensional partial differential equations (PDEs).
sentences.zh: 基于向后随机微分方程（BSDE）的深度学习方法已成为求解高维偏微分方程（PDE）时物理信息神经网络（PINN）的有竞争力替代方案。

sentences.en: By leveraging probabilistic representations, BSDE approaches can avoid the curse of dimensionality and often admit second-order-free training objectives that do not require explicit Hessian evaluations.
sentences.zh: 通过利用概率表示，BSDE 方法可以避免维数灾难，并往往容许不需要显式 Hessian 评估的免二阶训练目标。

sentences.en: It has recently been established that the commonly used Euler–Maruyama (EM) time discretization induces an intrinsic bias in BSDE training losses.
sentences.zh: 近来已确立，常用的 Euler–Maruyama（EM）时间离散化会在 BSDE 训练损失中诱导内在偏差。

sentences.en: While high-order schemes such as Heun can fully eliminate this bias, such schemes re-introduce second-order spatial derivatives and incur substantial computational overhead.
sentences.zh: 虽然 Heun 等高阶格式可以完全消除这一偏差，但这类格式会重新引入二阶空间导数并招致大量计算开销。

sentences.en: In this work, we provide a principled analysis of EM-induced loss bias and propose an unbiased, second-order-free training framework that preserves the computational advantages of BSDE methods.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们对 EM 诱导的损失偏差提供一个有原则的分析，并提出一个无偏、免二阶的训练框架，保留 BSDE 方法的计算优势。

sentences.en: Our code is available at https://github.com/seojaemin22/Un-EM-BSDE.
sentences.zh: 我们的代码见 https://github.com/seojaemin22/Un-EM-BSDE。

title_en: Unbiased Dynamic Pruning for Efficient Group-Based Policy Optimization
title_zh: 面向高效基于组的策略优化的无偏动态剪枝

sentences.en: Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) effectively scales LLM reasoning but incurs prohibitive computational costs due to its extensive group-based sampling requirement.
sentences.zh: 组相对策略优化（GRPO）有效扩展 LLM 推理，但因大量基于组的采样需求而招致高昂计算代价。

sentences.en: While recent selective data utilization methods can mitigate this overhead, they could induce estimation bias by altering the underlying sampling distribution, compromising theoretical rigor and convergence behavior.
sentences.zh: 虽然近来的选择性数据利用方法可以缓解这一开销，它们可能通过改变底层采样分布诱导估计偏差，损害理论严谨性与收敛行为。

sentences.en: To address this limitation, we propose Dynamic Pruning Policy Optimization (DPPO), a framework that enables dynamic pruning while preserving unbiased gradient estimation through importance sampling-based correction.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一局限，我们提出动态剪枝策略优化（DPPO），一个通过基于重要性采样的校正实现动态剪枝同时保持无偏梯度估计的框架。

sentences.en: By incorporating mathematically derived rescaling factors, DPPO significantly accelerates GRPO training without altering the optimization objective of the full-batch baseline.
sentences.zh: 通过纳入数学导出的重缩放因子，DPPO 在不变更全批次基线优化目标的情况下显著加速 GRPO 训练。

sentences.en: Furthermore, to mitigate the data sparsity induced by pruning, we introduce Dense Prompt Packing, a window-based greedy strategy that maximizes valid token density and hardware utilization.
sentences.zh: 此外，为缓解剪枝诱导的数据稀疏性，我们引入稠密提示打包，一个基于窗口的贪婪策略，最大化有效词元密度与硬件利用率。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that DPPO consistently accelerates training across diverse models and benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，DPPO 在多样模型与基准上一致加速训练。

sentences.en: For instance, on Qwen3-4B trained on MATH, DPPO achieves 2.37$\times$ training speedup and outperforms GRPO by 3.36\% in average accuracy across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 例如，在 MATH 上训练的 Qwen3-4B 上，DPPO 实现 2.37$\times$ 训练加速，并在六个数学推理基准上以 3.36\% 的平均准确率超越 GRPO。

title_en: Unbiased Principles, Robust Rewards
title_zh: 无偏原则，鲁棒奖励

sentences.en: Reward models are central to Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), especially for open-ended tasks where evaluation is inherently multi-dimensional.
sentences.zh: 奖励模型是基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）的核心，尤其对评估天然多维的开放式任务。

sentences.en: Recent Generative Reward Models (GRMs) improve interpretability by producing natural-language rationales and task-specific evaluation principles.
sentences.zh: 近来的生成式奖励模型（GRM）通过产出自然语言理由与任务特异评估原则来改进可解释性。

sentences.en: However, most existing GRMs generate principles after reading the actor's response, i.e., $Q+R \rightarrow P$.
sentences.zh: 然而，大多数现有 GRM 在读完演员回答后生成原则，即 $Q+R \rightarrow P$。

sentences.en: We show that this coupling induces Principle Drift: when the actor performs reward hacking (e.g., verbosity, self-aggrandizement, or hallucinated self-justifications), the reward model may shift its criteria to rationalize the response, yielding inflated scores that in turn reinforce hacking during RL.
sentences.zh: 我们表明这种耦合诱导原则漂移：当演员进行奖励黑客（例如冗长、自我吹嘘或幻觉式的自我辩护）时，奖励模型可能会转移其标准以合理化该回答，产生虚高分数，进而在 RL 期间强化黑客行为。

sentences.en: We propose IP-GRM (Independent Principle GRM), a two-stage framework that first generates principles solely from the question ($Q \rightarrow P$) and then evaluates the response conditioned on $(Q, R, P)$.
sentences.zh: 我们提出 IP-GRM（独立原则 GRM），一个两阶段框架，它首先仅从问题生成原则（$Q \rightarrow P$），然后在 $(Q, R, P)$ 条件下评估回答。

sentences.en: This decoupling keeps criteria invariant to response content, producing more objective and stable reward signals.
sentences.zh: 这种解耦使标准对回答内容不变，产生更客观、更稳定的奖励信号。

sentences.en: For efficient training, we further introduce a Principle Cache strategy that reuses principles within a group, improving GRPO throughput by 23.66\% while maintaining strict intra-group consistency.
sentences.zh: 为高效训练，我们进一步引入原则缓存策略，在一个组内复用原则，将 GRPO 吞吐量提升 23.66\%，同时保持严格的组内一致性。

sentences.en: In GRPO training on creative writing, IP-GRM suppresses reward hacking and improves WritingBench and CreativeWriting-v3 by up to +4.6 and +7.1 points based on Qwen3-8B, achieving state-of-the-art performance among open-source models.
sentences.zh: 在创意写作的 GRPO 训练中，基于 Qwen3-8B，IP-GRM 抑制奖励黑客，并将 WritingBench 与 CreativeWriting-v3 提升最高 +4.6 与 +7.1 分，在开源模型中取得最先进性能。

sentences.en: The model and dataset are open-sourced at https://github.com/ShadeCloak/IP-GRM.
sentences.zh: 模型与数据集已在 https://github.com/ShadeCloak/IP-GRM 开源。

title_en: Unbiased Reward Modeling from Implicit Feedback for LLM Alignment
title_zh: 面向 LLM 对齐的隐式反馈无偏奖励建模

sentences.en: Despite the success of reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), existing reward modeling methods largely rely on explicit feedback, which is costly to collect and difficult to scale.
sentences.zh: 尽管基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）取得了成功，现有奖励建模方法在很大程度上依赖显式反馈，而显式反馈收集成本高昂且难以扩展。

sentences.en: This work studies implicit reward modeling, learning reward models from implicit user feedback, such as clicks, copies and skips.
sentences.zh: 这项工作研究隐式奖励建模，从点击、复制与跳过等隐式用户反馈中学习奖励模型。

sentences.en: While scalable and cost-effective, implicit feedback poses two key challenges: (1) It lacks definitive negative samples, which makes standard positive-negative classification methods inapplicable;
sentences.zh: 虽然可扩展且成本高效，隐式反馈带来两个关键挑战：（1）它缺乏明确的负样本，使标准的正-负分类方法不适用；

sentences.en: (2) It suffers from selection bias, where responses have heterogeneous propensities to elicit feedback, which further obscures definitive negative samples.
sentences.zh: （2）它遭受选择偏差，其中回答以异构倾向引发反馈，这进一步模糊明确的负样本。

sentences.en: To address these challenges, we propose ImplicitRM, which learns unbiased reward models from implicit feedback.
sentences.zh: 为应对这些挑战，我们提出 ImplicitRM，它从隐式反馈中学习无偏奖励模型。

sentences.en: It stratifies training samples into four latent groups using a stratification model and derives a likelihood-maximization objective that is theoretically unbiased, thereby addressing both challenges.
sentences.zh: 它用分层模型将训练样本划分为四个潜在组，并推导一个理论上无偏的似然最大化目标，从而同时应对这两个挑战。

sentences.en: Experiments across diverse LLM backbones and benchmark datasets validate that ImplicitRM learns accurate reward models from implicit feedback and improves performance on downstream RLHF tasks.
sentences.zh: 跨多样 LLM 骨干与基准数据集上的实验验证了 ImplicitRM 能从隐式反馈学习准确奖励模型，并改进下游 RLHF 任务的性能。

title_en: Uncertainty-Aware Clarification in LLM Agents with Information Gain
title_zh: 带信息增益的 LLM 智能体不确定性感知澄清

sentences.en: Large Language Model (LLM) agents often operate under underspecified user instructions, where latent uncertainty over user intent leads to erroneous tool actions.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）智能体往往在规格不足的用户指令下运作，其中用户意图上的潜在不确定性导致错误的工具动作。

sentences.en: To address this challenge, we propose a goal-oriented clarification framework that aligns clarification behavior with ambiguity resolution.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一挑战，我们提出一个面向目标的澄清框架，将澄清行为与歧义消解对齐。

sentences.en: Central to our approach is the Information Gain Reward, a metric that quantifies the utility of clarification questions by measuring the Bayesian belief update towards the ground-truth goal induced by the clarification exchange.
sentences.zh: 我们方法的核心是信息增益奖励，一个通过测量由澄清交互诱致的朝向真值目标贝叶斯信念更新，来量化澄清问题效用的指标。

sentences.en: We train the clarifier (LLM) using this reward to optimize for high information gain, ensuring that clarifications effectively reduce uncertainty and improve task completion within the agent-tool-user environment.
sentences.zh: 我们用这一奖励训练澄清器（LLM）以优化高信息增益，确保澄清在智能体-工具-用户环境中有效降低不确定性并改进任务完成。

sentences.en: We validate our framework within a clarification-enhanced $\tau$-Bench environment, conducting cross-agent evaluations across five heterogeneous backbones.
sentences.zh: 我们在澄清增强的 $\tau$-Bench 环境中验证框架，在五个异构骨干上进行跨智能体评估。

sentences.en: Empirical results demonstrate that our method consistently improves the success rate by 3.7\% over the no-clarification baseline, while adding only 0.3 total interaction steps on average.
sentences.zh: 经验结果表明，我们的方法相对无澄清基线一致将成功率提升 3.7\%，同时平均仅增加 0.3 个总的交互步骤。

title_en: Uncertainty-Constrained Trustworthiness for Graph Learning
title_zh: 面向图学习的不确定性约束可信度

sentences.en: Graph learning has been increasingly deployed in critical and sensitive domains, raising pressing demands for trustworthiness-robustness, fairness, and beyond.
sentences.zh: 图学习越来越多地部署在关键与敏感领域，对可信度——鲁棒性、公平性等——提出迫切要求。

sentences.en: However, these properties are often undermined by various perturbations, which induce distributional uncertainty and compromise the trustworthiness of graph learning.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些性质往往被各种扰动削弱，扰动诱导分布不确定性并损害图学习的可信度。

sentences.en: To address this, we propose DICT, a novel framework that models distributional uncertainty to achieve trustworthy graph learning.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出 DICT，一个通过建模分布不确定性实现可信图学习的新颖框架。

sentences.en: Specifically, DICT formulates a unified optimization objective that captures perturbation-induced distributional shifts in graph topology, node features, and labels, and minimizes the worst-case risk over the uncertainty set.
sentences.zh: 具体地，DICT 表述一个统一的优化目标，捕捉图拓扑、节点特征与标签中的扰动诱导分布偏移，并最小化不确定性集上的最坏情况风险。

sentences.en: However, directly optimizing this objective in its primal form leads to an infinite-dimensional problem.
sentences.zh: 然而，在其原始形式下直接优化这一目标导致一个无限维问题。

sentences.en: To make this problem tractable, we integrate strong duality and local Lipschitz continuity of the loss, reformulating the objective as a finite-dimensional min-max problem.
sentences.zh: 为使该问题可处理，我们整合强对偶与损失的局部 Lipschitz 连续性，将该目标重构为一个有限维最小-最大问题。

sentences.en: We focus on robustness and fairness as primary instantiations of DICT because they are not only critical in real-world applications, but also provide transferable modeling principles for broader trustworthiness objectives.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦鲁棒性与公平性作为 DICT 的主要实例，因为它们不仅在实际应用中至关重要，还为更广泛的可信度目标提供可迁移的建模范式。

sentences.en: By formulating fairness in the form of an uncertainty set, DICT pioneers unified robustness and fairness within a single optimization framework.
sentences.zh: 通过以不确定性集的形式表述公平性，DICT 开创了在单一优化框架内统一鲁棒性与公平性。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across diverse benchmarks and backbones demonstrate that DICT consistently improves both robustness and fairness, validating the effectiveness and adaptability of the DICT framework.
sentences.zh: 跨多样基准与骨干的大量实验表明，DICT 一致改进鲁棒性与公平性，验证了 DICT 框架的有效性与适应性。

title_en: Uncertainty-Guided Exploration and Stable Planning for Sparse-Reward Manipulation from Limited Demonstrations
title_zh: 面向有限演示稀疏奖励操作的不确定性引导探索与稳定规划

sentences.en: Reinforcement learning from demonstrations (RLfD) offers a promising method for robotic manipulation with sparse rewards.
sentences.zh: 从演示学习强化学习（RLfD）为带稀疏奖励的机器人操作提供了有前景的方法。

sentences.en: However, limited demonstrations often cause agents to encounter out-of-distribution states where world models produce poor predictions.
sentences.zh: 然而，有限的演示往往使智能体遭遇分布外状态，在这些状态下世界模型产生糟糕的预测。

sentences.en: In multi-stage tasks, jointly optimizing a learned reward function and policy introduces a moving target problem, and the resulting non-stationarity intensifies the impact of uncertainty on policy learning.
sentences.zh: 在多阶段任务中，联合优化习得的奖励函数与策略引入移动目标问题，由此产生的非平稳性加剧了不确定性对策略学习的影响。

sentences.en: In this work, we propose QUEST, a model-based RL framework that adaptively switches between exploration and exploitation guided by uncertainty to achieve stable and efficient learning.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出 QUEST，一个由不确定性引导在探索与利用之间自适应切换的基于模型 RL 框架，以实现稳定高效的学习。

sentences.en: Specifically, our approach employs intrinsic rewards to encourage exploration, leverages ensemble dynamics for uncertainty-guided planning, and introduces a hybrid sampling strategy to prioritize rare successful stage transitions.
sentences.zh: 具体地，我们的方法用内在奖励鼓励探索，利用集成动力学进行不确定性引导的规划，并引入混合采样策略以优先考虑罕见的成功阶段转换。

sentences.en: We evaluate QUEST on challenging sparse-reward manipulation tasks with limited expert demonstrations.
sentences.zh: 我们在带有限专家演示的挑战性稀疏奖励操作任务上评估 QUEST。

sentences.en: Results show that QUEST outperforms state-of-the-art methods by 17\% on average, with gains increasing to 60\% on difficult tasks.
sentences.zh: 结果表明，QUEST 平均超出最先进方法 17\%，在困难任务上增益增至 60\%。

sentences.en: We further demonstrate successful zero-shot sim-to-real transfer on five real-world tasks.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步在五个真实世界任务上成功演示零样本 sim-to-real 迁移。

sentences.en: Project website: https://quest-official.github.io/QUEST/.
sentences.zh: 项目网站：https://quest-official.github.io/QUEST/。
