title_en: Uncovering Bias Mechanisms in Observational Studies
title_zh: 揭示观测研究中的偏差机制

sentences.en: Observational studies are a key resource for causal inference but are often affected by systematic biases.
sentences.zh: 观测研究是因果推断的关键资源，但往往受系统性偏差影响。

sentences.en: Prior work has focused mainly on detecting these biases, via sensitivity analyses and comparisons with randomized controlled trials, or mitigating them through debiasing techniques.
sentences.zh: 先前工作主要聚焦通过敏感性分析与随机对照试验比较来检测这些偏差，或通过去偏技术加以缓解。

sentences.en: However, there remains a lack of methodology for uncovering the underlying mechanisms driving these biases, *e.g.*, whether due to hidden confounding or selection of participants.
sentences.zh: 然而，仍然缺乏揭示驱动这些偏差的底层机制的方法，*例如*，究竟是隐藏混杂还是参与者选择所致。

sentences.en: In this work, we show that the relationship between bias magnitude and the predictive performance of nuisance function estimators (in the observational study) can help distinguish among common sources of bias.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们表明（在观测研究中的）偏差幅度与干扰函数估计器预测性能之间的关系可以帮助区分常见的偏差来源。

sentences.en: We validate our methodology through extensive synthetic experiments and a real-world case study, demonstrating its effectiveness in revealing the mechanisms behind observed biases.
sentences.zh: 我们通过大量合成实验与一个真实世界案例研究验证我们的方法，展示其在揭示观测偏差背后机制方面的有效性。

sentences.en: Our framework offers a new lens for understanding and characterizing bias in observational studies, with practical implications for improving causal inference.
sentences.zh: 我们的框架为理解与刻画观测研究中的偏差提供了一个新视角，对改进因果推断具有实际意义。

title_en: Uncovering Competency Gaps in Large Language Models and Their Benchmarks
title_zh: 揭示大语言模型及其基准中的能力差距

sentences.en: The evaluation of large language models relies heavily on standardized benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型的评估在很大程度上依赖标准化基准。

sentences.en: These benchmarks provide useful aggregated metrics, but can obscure (i) particular sub-areas where the models are weak ("model gaps") and (ii) imbalanced coverage in the benchmarks themselves ("benchmark gaps").
sentences.zh: 这些基准提供有用的聚合指标，但可能掩盖（i）模型薄弱的具体子领域（“模型差距”）以及（ii）基准本身覆盖的不平衡（“基准差距”）。

sentences.en: To automatically uncover both types of gaps, we propose a simple new method using concept activations from sparse autoencoders, to identify fine-grained gaps on a per-concept basis.
sentences.zh: 为自动揭示这两类差距，我们提出一个简单的新方法，用稀疏自编码器的概念激活，以逐概念为基础识别细粒度的差距。

sentences.en: The method also benefits from grounding evaluation in the model's internal representations, as well as easy comparison across benchmarks.
sentences.zh: 该方法还受益于将评估扎根于模型的内部表示，以及跨基准的轻松比较。

sentences.en: We applied the method to five popular open-source models and more than a dozen benchmarks, as illustrative examples.
sentences.zh: 我们将该方法应用于五个流行的开源模型与十几个基准，作为示例。

sentences.en: As validation of the approach, we found that our automatic, unsupervised method was able to recover model gaps that have been previously documented in the literature (e.g. relating to sycophancy), in addition to identifying novel model gaps.
sentences.zh: 作为对该方法的验证，我们发现我们的自动、无监督方法能够恢复文献中先前已记录的模型差距（例如与奉承相关的差距），并识别新颖的模型差距。

sentences.en: We were also able to automatically uncover benchmark gaps: core concepts that should fall within the scope of a given benchmark.
sentences.zh: 我们还能够自动揭示基准差距：应当落到给定基准范围之内的核心概念。

sentences.en: Our "competency gaps" method can be used to complement existing benchmarks, by providing a concept-level decomposition of model behavior, and by helping benchmark developers iterate upon benchmark design.
sentences.zh: 我们的“能力差距”方法可用于补充现有基准，提供模型行为的概念级分解，并帮助基准开发者迭代基准设计。

sentences.en: Code is available at https://competency-gaps.github.io.
sentences.zh: 代码见 https://competency-gaps.github.io。

title_en: Uncovering Grounding IDs: How External Cues Shape Multi-Modal Binding
title_zh: 揭示定语 ID：外部线索如何塑造多模态绑定

sentences.en: Large vision–language models (LVLMs) perform well on multimodal tasks, but their ability to reason and precisely align visual and textual information still has room for improvement.
sentences.zh: 大型视觉–语言模型（LVLM）在多模态任务上表现良好，但它们的推理能力与精准对齐视觉和文本信息的能力仍有改进空间。

sentences.en: In this study, we show that external visual cues, such as symbols or grid lines, help LVLMs form more accurate connections between visual components, such as objects, and their corresponding textual descriptions, improving their grounding and reasoning abilities.
sentences.zh: 在这项研究中，我们表明符号或网格线等外部视觉线索帮助 LVLM 在视觉组件（如物体）与对应文本描述之间形成更准确的连接，提升它们的定语与推理能力。

sentences.en: We introduce the concept of Grounding IDs, which are latent identifiers that arise within the model as a result of external cues structuring both visual and textual modalities.
sentences.zh: 我们引入定语 ID 的概念，它们是模型内部因外部线索同时结构化视觉与文本模态而产生的潜在标识符。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals that partition-inducing external cues lead to Grounding IDs that make better alignment between corresponding visual and text representations, helping the model focus on relevant information.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示，诱导划分的外部线索产生能在对应视觉与文本表示之间更好地对齐的定语 ID，帮助模型聚焦相关信息。

sentences.en: We find that Grounding IDs enhance attention between related components, improving cross-modal grounding and reducing hallucinations.
sentences.zh: 我们发现定语 ID 增强相关组件之间的注意力，改进跨模态接地并减少幻觉。

sentences.en: Overall, our results show that Grounding IDs are a key mechanism that enables external cues to improve cross-modal alignment, reduce errors, and enhance the overall performance of LVLMs across a range of multimodal tasks.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果表明定语 ID 是使外部线索能够改进跨模态对齐、减少错误并提升 LVLM 在多种多模态任务上整体性能的关键机制。

title_en: Uncovering Hidden Triggers: Backdoor Attribution in Language Models
title_zh: 揭示隐藏触发器：语言模型中的后门归因

sentences.en: Fine-tuned Large Language Models (LLMs) are vulnerable to backdoor attacks through data poisoning, yet the internal mechanisms governing these attacks remain a black box.
sentences.zh: 微调后的大语言模型（LLM）容易受到通过数据投毒的后门攻击，但管理这些攻击的内部机制仍是一个黑盒。

sentences.en: Previous research on interpretability for LLM safety tends to focus on alignment, jailbreak, and hallucination, but overlooks backdoor mechanisms, making it difficult to understand and fully eliminate the backdoor threat.
sentences.zh: 先前关于 LLM 安全可解释性的研究往往聚焦对齐、越狱与幻觉，却忽视后门机制，使人难以理解并彻底消除后门威胁。

sentences.en: In this paper, aiming to bridge this gap, we explore the interpretable mechanisms of LLM backdoors through Backdoor Attribution (BkdAttr), a tripartite causal analysis framework.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，为弥合这一空白，我们通过后门归因（BkdAttr），一个三方因果分析框架，探索 LLM 后门的可解释机制。

sentences.en: We first introduce the Backdoor Probe that proves the existence of learnable backdoor features encoded within the representations.
sentences.zh: 我们首先引入后门探针，证明表示内编码了可学习后门特征的存在。

sentences.en: Building on this insight, we further develop Backdoor Attention Head Attribution (BAHA), efficiently pinpointing the specific attention heads responsible for processing these features.
sentences.zh: 在此洞见之上，我们进一步开发后门注意力头归因（BAHA），高效定位负责处理这些特征的特定注意力头。

sentences.en: Our primary experiments reveals these heads are relatively sparse; ablating a minimal \textbf{$\sim$ 3%} of total heads is sufficient to reduce the Attack Success Rate (ASR) by \textbf{over 90%}.
sentences.zh: 我们的初步实验揭示这些头相对稀疏；消融总量中最少的 \textbf{$\sim$ 3%} 头部足以将攻击成功率（ASR）降低 \textbf{超过 90%}。

sentences.en: More importantly, we further employ these findings to construct the Backdoor Vector derived from these attributed heads as a master controller for the backdoor.
sentences.zh: 更重要的是，我们进一步利用这些发现，构造源自这些归因头的后门向量，作为后门的主控制器。

sentences.en: Through only \textbf{1-point} intervention on \textbf{single} representation, the vector can either boost ASR up to \textbf{$\sim$ 100% $\uparrow$} on clean inputs, or completely neutralize backdoor, suppressing ASR down to \textbf{ $\sim$ 0%} on triggered inputs.
sentences.zh: 仅对 \textbf{单个}表示进行 \textbf{1 点}干预，该向量既可以在干净输入上将 ASR 提升至最高 \textbf{$\sim$ 100% $\uparrow$}，也可以彻底中和后门，将触发输入上的 ASR 压低至 \textbf{$\sim$ 0%}。

sentences.en: In conclusion, our work pioneers the exploration of mechanistic interpretability in LLM backdoors, demonstrating a powerful method for backdoor control and revealing actionable insights for the community.
sentences.zh: 总之，我们的工作开创了 LLM 后门机制可解释性的探索，展示了一种强大的后门控制方法，并为社区揭示可操作的洞见。

title_en: Uncovering Latent Communication Patterns in Brain Networks via Adaptive Flow Routing
title_zh: 经自适应流路由揭示脑网络中的潜在通信模式

sentences.en: Unraveling how macroscopic cognitive phenotypes emerge from microscopic neuronal connectivity remains one of the core pursuits of neuroscience.
sentences.zh: 揭示宏观认知表型如何从微观神经元连接中涌现，仍是神经科学的核心追求之一。

sentences.en: To this end, researchers typically leverage multi-modal information from structural connectivity (SC) and functional connectivity (FC) to complete downstream tasks.
sentences.zh: 为此，研究者通常利用来自结构连接（SC）与功能连接（FC）的多模态信息来完成下游任务。

sentences.en: Recent methodologies explore the intricate coupling mechanisms between SC and FC, attempting to fuse their representations at the regional level.
sentences.zh: 近来的方法探索 SC 与 FC 之间复杂的耦合机制，试图在区域级别融合它们的表示。

sentences.en: However, while these approaches do incorporate useful neuroscientific observations, they predominantly operate at a topological or architectural level and lack a principled formulation grounded in neural communication dynamics.
sentences.zh: 然而，虽然这些方法确实纳入有用的神经科学观察，它们主要运作在拓扑或架构层面，缺乏植根于神经通信动力学的有原则表述。

sentences.en: Consequently, they are limited in quantifying how information is actually routed between neural regions, and thus cannot fully explain why SC and FC exhibit dynamic states of both coupling and heterogeneity.
sentences.zh: 因此，它们在量化信息如何在神经区域间实际路由方面受限，无法完全解释为何 SC 与 FC 展现耦合与异质性兼具的动态状态。

sentences.en: In this paper, we formulate multi-modal fusion through the lens of neural communication dynamics and propose the Adaptive Flow Routing Network (AFR-Net), a physics-informed framework that models how structural constraints give rise to functional communication patterns, enabling interpretable discovery of critical neural pathways.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们透过神经通信动力学的视角表述多模态融合，并提出自适应流路由网络（AFR-Net），一个对结构约束如何产生功能通信模式建模的物理知情框架，实现关键神经通路的可解释发现。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments demonstrate that AFR-Net significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines.
sentences.zh: 大量实验表明，AFR-Net 显著优于最先进基线。

sentences.en: The code is available at \url{https://github.com/Skyyyy0920/AFR-Net}.
sentences.zh: 代码见 \url{https://github.com/Skyyyy0920/AFR-Net}。

title_en: Uncovering the Gradient Geometry of Long CoT: A Spectral-guided Approach to Reasoning Distillation
title_zh: 揭示长 CoT 的梯度几何：一种谱引导的推理蒸馏方法

sentences.en: Large reasoning models (LRMs) achieve remarkable reasoning performance by generating long chains-of-thought (CoT).
sentences.zh: 大型推理模型（LRM）通过生成长思维链（CoT）实现卓越的推理性能。

sentences.en: However, standard supervised fine-tuning (SFT) treats all tokens uniformly, indiscriminately minimizing loss across both essential reasoning steps and those that are noisy, redundant, or instance-specific.
sentences.zh: 然而，标准监督微调（SFT）对所有词元一视同仁，不分青红皂白地在基本推理步骤与带噪、冗余或实例特异的步骤上最小化损失。

sentences.en: This often leads student models to memorize superficial patterns rather than acquire generalizable reasoning capabilities.
sentences.zh: 这往往导致学生模型记住表面模式，而非获得可泛化的推理能力。

sentences.en: To better understand this limitation, we introduce \textit{Loss Subspace Attribution}, a gradient decomposition analysis approach that uncovers a striking geometric structure:  Gradients corresponding to effective reasoning predominantly lie within a low-rank consensus subspace, while conflicting or unstructured signals dominate the residual subspace.
sentences.zh: 为更好地理解这一局限，我们引入\textit{损失子空间归因}，一种梯度分解分析方法，揭示一个惊人的几何结构：对应有效推理的梯度主要位于低秩共识子空间内，而冲突或无结构的信号主导残差子空间。

sentences.en: Guided by this insight, we propose \textbf{\textit{Spectral-guided Learning}}, a step-level distillation strategy that uses spectral strength to identify reasoning steps aligned with the consensus subspace and prioritizes their contribution to parameter updates, while suppressing gradients from the residual subspace.
sentences.zh: 在此洞见引导下，我们提出\textbf{\textit{谱引导学习}}，一种步骤级蒸馏策略，用谱强度识别与共识子空间对齐的推理步骤，并优先考虑它们对参数更新的贡献，同时抑制来自残差子空间的梯度。

sentences.en: Experiments across various LRMs and diverse complex reasoning tasks consistently demonstrate that focusing optimization on the consensus subspace yields more robust and generalizable student models.
sentences.zh: 跨多种 LRM 与多样复杂推理任务的实验一致表明，将优化聚焦于共识子空间能产生更鲁棒且可泛化的学生模型。

title_en: Uncovering the Latent Potential of Deep Intermediate Representations
title_zh: 揭示深层中间表示的潜在能力

sentences.en: Foundational Models pretrained on huge amount of data learn representations that evolve across depth, forming a hierarchy of embeddings with distinct semantic content and geometric structure.
sentences.zh: 在海量数据上预训练的基础模型学到随深度演化的表示，形成带不同语义内容与几何结构的嵌入层级。

sentences.en: Contrary to the widespread practice of using only the final layer or shallow mixtures, we show that task-relevant information is distributed non-monotonically across layers and cannot be recovered by naive aggregation.
sentences.zh: 与只使用最后一层或浅层混合的普遍做法相反，我们表明任务相关信息跨层非单调分布，无法被朴素聚合恢复。

sentences.en: Through a geometric and empirical study across multiple modalities, we show that effective transfer depends on identifying which layers encode task-discriminative structure and how their embeddings are geometrically organized.
sentences.zh: 经过跨多种模态的几何与经验研究，我们表明有效迁移取决于识别哪些层编码任务判别性结构，以及它们的嵌入在几何上如何组织。

sentences.en: We introduce Layer-wise Optimal Embedding Selection (LOES), a constructive spectral method that identifies task-discriminative subspaces by minimizing residual error under orthogonality and isotropy constraints.
sentences.zh: 我们引入逐层最优嵌入选择（LOES），一种构造性谱方法，通过在正交性与各向同性约束下最小化残差误差来识别任务判别性子空间。

sentences.en: To align fine-tuning with this selection principle, we further propose Geometric Regularization Loss (GeoReg), which enforces a simplicial structure on class manifolds and stabilizes representation geometry during fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 为使微调与这一选择原则对齐，我们进一步提出几何正则化损失（GeoReg），它在类流形上强制单纯形结构，并在微调期间稳定表示几何。

sentences.en: Across a wide range of architectures, depths, modalities, and data regimes, LOES consistently outperforms standard baselines, with gains that grow as model depth increases.
sentences.zh: 跨广泛的架构、深度、模态与数据体制，LOES 一致优于标准基线，且增益随模型深度增加而扩大。

sentences.en: Beyond accuracy, our method reveals how semantic factors are distributed across layers, thereby enabling cross-lingual and cross-modal interpretability analyses.
sentences.zh: 超越准确率，我们的方法揭示语义因子如何跨层分布，从而支持跨语言与跨模态的可解释性分析。

sentences.en: Together, our results provide strong evidence that layerwise embedding geometry is not incidental but central to how deep models represent and transfer knowledge.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的结果为逐层嵌入几何并非偶然、而是深层模型表示与迁移知识的核心提供了有力证据。

title_en: Understand and Accelerate Memory Processing Pipeline for Large Language Model Inference
title_zh: 理解并加速大语言模型推理的记忆处理流程

sentences.en: Modern large language models (LLMs) increasingly depend on efficient long-context processing and generation mechanisms, including sparse attention, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), and compressed contextual memory, to solve complex tasks.
sentences.zh: 现代大语言模型（LLM）日益依赖高效的长上下文处理与生成机制，包括稀疏注意力、检索增强生成（RAG）与压缩的上下文记忆，来解决复杂任务。

sentences.en: We show that these optimizations can be unified into a four-stage memory processing pipeline: *Prepare Memory*, *Compute Relevancy*, *Retrieval*, and *Apply to Inference*.
sentences.zh: 我们表明这些优化可以统一为一个四阶段记忆处理流程：*准备记忆*、*计算相关性*、*检索*与*应用于推理*。

sentences.en: Through systematic profiling, we identify a 22\%-97\% memory processing overhead in LLM inference and strong computational heterogeneity across stages in memory processing.
sentences.zh: 通过系统化剖析，我们识别出 LLM 推理中 22\%-97\% 的记忆处理开销，以及记忆处理各阶段之间的强计算异质性。

sentences.en: Motivated by this insight, we argue that **heterogeneous systems** are well-suited to accelerate memory processing and thus end-to-end inference.
sentences.zh: 受这一洞见启发，我们认为**异构系统**非常适合加速记忆处理，从而加速端到端推理。

sentences.en: We demonstrate this approach on a GPU-FPGA system by offloading sparse, irregular, and memory-bounded operations to FPGAs while retaining compute-intensive operations on GPUs.
sentences.zh: 我们在一个 GPU-FPGA 系统上演示了这一方法，将稀疏、不规则且受内存约束的操作卸载到 FPGA，同时将计算密集操作保留在 GPU 上。

sentences.en: Evaluated on an AMD MI210 GPU and an Alveo U55C FPGA, our system is up to $2.2\times$ faster and $4.7\times$ energy reduction across multiple LLM optimizations than the GPU baseline (with similar results on NVIDIA A100), establishing heterogeneous systems as a practical direction for efficient LLM inference and informing future heterogeneous hardware design.
sentences.zh: 在 AMD MI210 GPU 与 Alveo U55C FPGA 上评估，我们的系统跨多种 LLM 优化比 GPU 基线快最高 $2.2\times$，能耗降低 $4.7\times$（在 NVIDIA A100 上有类似结果），将异构系统确立为高效 LLM 推理的实用方向，并指导未来异构硬件设计。

title_en: Understanding and Mitigating Token-Pruning-Induced Vulnerabilities in VLMs
title_zh: 理解并缓解 VLM 中词元剪枝诱导的漏洞

sentences.en: Token-Pruning accelerates Vision-Language Models by removing redundant visual tokens, yet its safety implications remain underexplored.
sentences.zh: 词元剪枝通过移除冗余视觉词元加速视觉-语言模型，但其安全影响仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: In this work, we present the first comprehensive safety evaluation of Token-Pruning mechanisms and find that: most pruning strategies significantly degrade safety as pruning ratios increase, whereas Query-based Compression shows the opposite, with extreme pruning (up to 99.8%), unexpectedly improves model safety.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们提出对词元剪枝机制的首个全面安全评估，并发现：随着剪枝比增加，大多数剪枝策略显著降低安全性，而基于查询的压缩则相反——极端剪枝（最高 99.8%）反而意外提升模型安全性。

sentences.en: This sharp contrast prompts a key question: How do different Token-Pruning strategies reshape model safety behavior, and is it possible to enhance safety without sacrificing acceleration?
sentences.zh: 这一鲜明对比引出一个关键问题：不同词元剪枝策略如何重塑模型安全行为，能否在牺牲加速的前提下提升安全性？

sentences.en: To answer this, we identify an unrecognized mechanism, termed Pruning-Induced Malicious Amplification, where removal of background tokens triggers a side effect: forcing the model's attention to collapse onto a few retained malicious anchors within the foreground, inadvertently amplifying their toxic semantics under jailbreak.
sentences.zh: 为回答这一点，我们识别出一个未被认识到的机制，称为剪枝诱导的恶意放大，其中移除背景词元触发一个副作用：迫使模型注意力坍缩到前景中少数保留的恶意锚点上，在越狱下无意中放大它们的有毒语义。

sentences.en: To address that, we propose an inference-time and plug-and-play Safety-Aware Pruning (SAP) mechanism that counteracts such dominance via three steps: (1) identifying malicious anchors, (2) restoring pruned benign tokens, and (3) reallocating excessive attention from malicious anchors to benign tokens.
sentences.zh: 为应对这一点，我们提出一个推理时且即插即用的安全感知剪枝（SAP）机制，通过三个步骤抵消这种支配：（1）识别恶意锚点，（2）恢复被剪的良性词元，（3）将过度注意力从恶意锚点重新分配给良性词元。

sentences.en: Extensive experiments across three safety and four utility benchmarks demonstrate that SAP mitigates pruning-induced vulnerabilities, i.e., reducing ASR by up to 62%, without compromising efficiency or utility.
sentences.zh: 跨三个安全与四个效用基准的大量实验表明，SAP 缓解了剪枝诱导的漏洞，即在不损害效率或效用的情况下将 ASR 降低最高 62%。

title_en: Understanding Behavior Cloning with Action Quantization
title_zh: 理解带动作量化的行为克隆

sentences.en: Behavior cloning is a fundamental paradigm in machine learning, enabling policy learning from expert demonstrations across robotics, autonomous driving, and generative models.
sentences.zh: 行为克隆是机器学习的一个基本范式，能够在机器人、自动驾驶与生成模型等场景中从专家演示学习策略。

sentences.en: Autoregressive models like transformer have proven remarkably effective, from large language models (LLMs) to vision-language-action systems (VLAs).
sentences.zh: Transformer 等自回归模型已被证明极为有效，从大语言模型（LLM）到视觉-语言-动作系统（VLA）皆然。

sentences.en: However, applying autoregressive models to continuous control requires discretizing actions through quantization, a practice widely adopted yet poorly understood theoretically.
sentences.zh: 然而，将自回归模型应用于连续控制需要通过量化离散化动作，这是一项被广泛采用但在理论上仍理解不足的做法。

sentences.en: This paper provides theoretical foundations for this practice.
sentences.zh: 本文为这一做法提供理论基础。

sentences.en: We analyze how quantization error propagates along the horizon and interacts with statistical sample complexity.
sentences.zh: 我们分析量化误差如何沿视界传播并与统计样本复杂度相互作用。

sentences.en: We show that behavior cloning with quantized actions and log-loss achieves optimal sample complexity—matching existing lower bounds—and incurs only polynomial horizon dependence on quantization error, provided the dynamics are stable and the policy satisfies a probabilistic smoothness condition.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，带量化动作与 log 损失的行为克隆实现最优样本复杂度——匹配现有下界——且对量化误差仅有多项式视界依赖，前提是动力学稳定且策略满足概率光滑性条件。

sentences.en: We further characterize when different quantization schemes satisfy or violate these requirements, and propose a model-based augmentation that provably improves the error bound without requiring policy smoothness.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步刻画不同量化方案何时满足或违反这些要求，并提出一个基于模型的增强，可证明地在无需策略光滑性的情况下改进误差界。

sentences.en: Finally, we establish fundamental limits that jointly capture the effects of quantization error and statistical complexity.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们确立联合捕捉量化误差与统计复杂度影响的基本极限。

title_en: Understanding Catastrophic Forgetting In LoRA via Mean-Field Attention Dynamics
title_zh: 经平均场注意力动力学理解 LoRA 中的灾难性遗忘

sentences.en: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) is the dominant parameter-efficient fine-tuning method due to its favorable compute-performance trade-off, yet it suffers from catastrophic forgetting.
sentences.zh: 低秩适配（LoRA）因其有利的计算-性能权衡而成为主导的参数高效微调方法，但它仍遭受灾难性遗忘。

sentences.en: We study forgetting through a tractable _mean-field self-attention_ toy model, where tokens evolve as an interacting particle system and LoRA acts as a low-rank perturbation.
sentences.zh: 我们通过一个可处理的_mean-field 自注意力_玩具模型研究遗忘，其中词元作为相互作用粒子系统演化，而 LoRA 充当低秩扰动。

sentences.en: Using tools from partial differential equations and dynamical systems, we characterize regimes suggesting a phase transition between forgetting and non-forgetting behavior.
sentences.zh: 利用偏微分方程与动力系统的工具，我们刻画了提示遗忘与不遗忘行为之间相变的体制。

sentences.en: We show that one phase transition appears with respect to the norm of the perturbation, and the other with respect to the depth of the Transformers.
sentences.zh: 我们表明一个相变相对扰动范数出现，另一个相对 Transformer 深度出现。

sentences.en: We further bound the time-to-deviation in terms of the perturbation size and spectral quantities, and corroborate the predicted trends with experiments and exploratory analyses on real models under LoRA fine-tuning.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步用扰动大小与谱量界定偏差时间，并在 LoRA 微调下的真实模型上用实验与探索性分析证实预测趋势。

title_en: Understanding Data Temporality Impact on Large Language Models Pre-training
title_zh: 理解数据时间性对大语言模型预训练的影响

sentences.en: Large language models (LLMs) are typically trained on shuffled corpora, yielding models whose knowledge is frozen at training time and whose temporal grounding remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 大语言模型（LLM）通常在打乱的语料上训练，产生知识在训练时冻结、时间接地在很大程度上未被很好理解的模型。

sentences.en: In this work, we study the impact of pretraining dynamics on the acquisition of time-sensitive factual knowledge, focusing specifically on data ordering.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们研究预训练动力学对获取时敏事实知识的影响，特别聚焦数据排序。

sentences.en: Our main contributions are twofold.
sentences.zh: 我们的主要贡献有两方面。

sentences.en: First, we introduce a comprehensive benchmark of over 7,000 temporally grounded questions and an evaluation protocol that enables analysis of whether models correctly associate facts with their corresponding time periods.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们引入一个包含 7,000 多个时间接地问题与一个评估协议的综合基准，使能够分析模型是否将事实与其对应时间段正确关联。

sentences.en: Second, we pretrain 6B-parameter language models on temporally ordered Common Crawl snapshots and compare them against standard shuffled pretraining.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们在按时间排序的 Common Crawl 快照上预训练 6B 参数语言模型，并与标准打乱预训练比较。

sentences.en: Our results show that sequentially trained models match shuffled baselines on general language understanding and common knowledge while consistently exhibiting more up-to-date and temporally precise knowledge.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，序贯训练的模型在通用语言理解与常识上匹配打乱基线，同时一致展现更新的、时间上更精确的知识。

sentences.en: Temporally ordered pretraining yields improved factual freshness, while shuffled pretraining peaks on older data, possibly due to increased factual repetition.
sentences.zh: 按时间排序的预训练带来改进的事实时效性，而打乱预训练在较老数据上达到峰值，可能是由于事实重复增加。

sentences.en: These findings, along with the release of our checkpoints and datasets, provide a foundation for future research on continual learning for large language models.
sentences.zh: 这些发现，连同我们发布的检查点与数据集，为未来大语言模型持续学习研究提供了基础。

title_en: Understanding Deep Representation Learning via Layerwise Feature Compression and Discrimination
title_zh: 经逐层特征压缩与判别理解深层表示学习

sentences.en: Over the past decade, deep learning has proven to be a highly effective tool for learning meaningful features from raw data.
sentences.zh: 在过去十年中，深度学习已被证明是从原始数据学习有意义特征的高效工具。

sentences.en: However, it remains an open question how deep networks perform hierarchical feature learning across layers.
sentences.zh: 然而，深层网络如何跨层执行层级特征学习仍是一个开放问题。

sentences.en: In this work, we attempt to unveil this mystery by investigating the structures of intermediate features.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们通过研究中间特征的结构尝试揭示这一谜团。

sentences.en: Motivated by our empirical findings that linear layers mimic the roles of deep layers in nonlinear networks for feature learning, we explore how deep linear networks transform input data into output by investigating the output (i.e., features) of each layer after training in the context of multi-class classification problems.
sentences.zh: 受我们的经验发现（在线性特征学习中，线性层模仿了非线性网络中深层的作用）启发，我们在多类分类问题的背景下，通过研究训练后每一层的输出（即特征），探索深层线性网络如何将输入数据变换为输出。

sentences.en: Toward this goal, we first define metrics to measure within-class compression and between-class discrimination of intermediate features, respectively.
sentences.zh: 为达这一目标，我们首先定义分别衡量中间特征类内压缩与类间判别的指标。

sentences.en: Through theoretical analysis of these two metrics, we show that the evolution of features follows a simple and quantitative pattern from shallow to deep layers when the input data is nearly orthogonal and the network weights are minimum-norm, balanced, and approximately low-rank: each layer of the linear network progressively compresses within-class features at a geometric rate and discriminates between-class features at a linear rate with respect to the number of layers that data have passed through.
sentences.zh: 通过对这两个指标的理论分析，我们表明当输入数据近似正交且网络权重为最小范数、平衡且近似低秩时，特征演化从浅层到深层遵循一个简单而定量的模式：线性网络每一层以几何速率渐进压缩类内特征，并以线性速率（相对数据经过的层数）判别类间特征。

sentences.en: To the best of our knowledge, this is the first quantitative characterization of feature evolution in hierarchical representations of deep linear networks.
sentences.zh: 据我们所知，这是对深层线性网络层级表示中特征演化的首次定量刻画。

sentences.en: Moreover, our extensive experiments not only validate our theoretical results but also reveal a similar pattern in deep nonlinear networks, which aligns well with recent empirical studies.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的大量实验不仅验证了我们的理论结果，还在深层非线性网络中揭示类似模式，这与近来的经验研究高度一致。

sentences.en: Finally, we demonstrate the practical value of our results in transfer learning.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们演示我们的结果在迁移学习中的实用价值。

title_en: Understanding Dynamic Compute Allocation in Recurrent Transformers
title_zh: 理解循环 Transformer 中的动态计算分配

sentences.en: Token-level adaptive computation seeks to reduce inference cost by allocating more computation to harder tokens and less to easier ones.
sentences.zh: 词元级自适应计算旨在通过为较难词元分配更多计算、为更容易词元分配更少计算来降低推理成本。

sentences.en: However, prior work is primarily evaluated on natural-language benchmarks using task-level metrics, where token-level difficulty is unobservable and confounded with architectural factors, making it unclear whether compute allocation truly aligns with underlying complexity.
sentences.zh: 然而，先前工作主要用任务级指标在自然语言基准上评估，其中词元级难度不可观测且与架构因素混淆，使计算分配是否真正与底层复杂度对齐变得不明。

sentences.en: We address this gap through three contributions.
sentences.zh: 我们通过三个贡献来弥合这一空白。

sentences.en: First, we introduce a complexity-controlled evaluation paradigm using existing algorithmic and synthetic language tasks with parameterized difficulty, enabling direct testing of token-level compute allocation.
sentences.zh: 首先，我们引入一个复杂度受控的评估范式，利用带可参数化难度的现有算法与合成语言任务，从而能够直接测试词元级计算分配。

sentences.en: Second, we propose ANIRA, a unified recurrent Transformer framework that supports per-token variable-depth computation while isolating compute allocation decisions from other model factors.
sentences.zh: 其次，我们提出 ANIRA，一个统一的循环 Transformer 框架，支持逐词元可变深度计算，同时将计算分配决策与其他模型因素隔离。

sentences.en: Third, we use this framework to conduct a systematic analysis of token-level adaptive computation across alignment with complexity, generalization, and decision timing.
sentences.zh: 第三，我们用这一框架对词元级自适应计算进行系统分析，涵盖与复杂度、泛化及决策时机的对齐。

sentences.en: Our results show that compute allocation aligned with task complexity can emerge without explicit difficulty supervision, but such alignment does not imply algorithmic generalization: models fail to extrapolate to unseen input sizes despite allocating additional computation.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，与任务复杂度对齐的计算分配可以在无显式难度监督的情况下涌现，但这种对齐并不意味着算法泛化：尽管分配了额外计算，模型仍无法外推到未见过的输入规模。

sentences.en: We further find that early compute decisions rely on static structural cues, whereas online halting more closely tracks algorithmic execution state.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步发现，早期计算决策依赖静态结构线索，而在线停机更紧密地追踪算法执行状态。

sentences.en: Code: https://github.com/merlresearch/ANIRA
sentences.zh: 代码：https://github.com/merlresearch/ANIRA

title_en: Understanding Dynamics of Adam in Zero-Sum Games: An ODE Approach
title_zh: 用 ODE 方法理解零和博弈中 Adam 的动力学

sentences.en: The remarkable success of the Adam in training neural networks has naturally led to the widespread use of its descent-ascent counterpart, Adam-DA, for solving zero-sum games.
sentences.zh: Adam 在训练神经网络方面的非凡成功，自然导致其下降-上升对应物 Adam-DA 在求解零和博弈中被广泛使用。

sentences.en: Despite its popularity in practice, a rigorous theoretical understanding of Adam-DA still lags behind.
sentences.zh: 尽管在实践中广受欢迎，对 Adam-DA 的严谨理论理解仍相对滞后。

sentences.en: In this paper, we derive ordinary differential equations (ODEs) that serve as continuous-time limits of the Adam-DA.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们推导作为 Adam-DA 连续时间极限的常微分方程（ODE）。

sentences.en: These ODEs closely approximate the discrete-time dynamics of Adam-DA, providing a tractable analytical framework for understanding its behavior in zero-sum games.
sentences.zh: 这些 ODE 紧密逼近 Adam-DA 的离散时间动力学，为理解其在零和博弈中的行为提供了一个可处理的解析框架。

sentences.en: Using this ODE approach, we investigate two fundamental aspects of Adam-DA: local convergence and implicit gradient regularization.
sentences.zh: 利用这一 ODE 方法，我们研究 Adam-DA 的两个基本方面：局部收敛与隐式梯度正则化。

sentences.en: Our analysis reveals that the roles of the first- and second-order momentum parameters in zero-sum games are exactly the opposite of their well-documented effects in minimization problems.
sentences.zh: 我们的分析揭示，一阶与二阶动量参数在零和博弈中的作用，与其在最小化问题中记录良好的效应完全相反。

sentences.en: We validate these predictions through GAN experiments across multiple architectures and datasets, demonstrating the practical implications of this reversed momentum effect.
sentences.zh: 我们通过跨多种架构与数据集的 GAN 实验验证这些预测，展示这种反向动量效应的实际意义。

title_en: Understanding Generalization and Forgetting in In-Context Continual Learning
title_zh: 理解上下文持续学习中的泛化与遗忘

sentences.en: In-context learning (ICL) derives its power from enabling Large Language Models to adapt to new tasks via prompt-based reasoning alone, entirely bypassing the need for parameter updates.
sentences.zh: 上下文学习（ICL）的力量源于使大语言模型能仅凭基于提示的推理适应新任务，完全无需参数更新。

sentences.en: Existing theories primarily study ICL in single-task settings, while real-world prompts often contain sequences of heterogeneous tasks, leaving a gap in understanding whether Large Language Models implicitly perform continual learning during inference.
sentences.zh: 现有理论主要研究单任务设定中的 ICL，而真实世界提示往往包含异构任务序列，在理解大语言模型是否在推理期间隐式执行持续学习方面留下空白。

sentences.en: To bridge this gap, we propose the first theoretical framework for in-context continual learning, modeling how a pretrained Transformer processes multiple sequential tasks within a single prompt through shared attention mechanisms.
sentences.zh: 为弥合这一空白，我们提出首个上下文持续学习的理论框架，建模预训练 Transformer 如何通过共享注意力机制在单个提示内处理多个序贯任务。

sentences.en: Focusing on linear and masked linear self-attention, we derive error expressions for model predictions under sequential task prompts and analyze their generalization and forgetting behavior.
sentences.zh: 聚焦线性与遮蔽线性自注意力，我们推导序贯任务提示下模型预测的误差表达式，并分析其泛化与遗忘行为。

sentences.en: Our results reveal that standard attention mechanisms inevitably induce inter-task interference by uniformly or causally aggregating historical contexts, leading to systematic bias.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果显示，标准注意力机制通过均匀或因果地聚合历史上下文，不可避免地诱导任务间干扰，导致系统性偏差。

sentences.en: We further provide a bias–variance–interference decomposition of prediction error, characterizing when historical in-context information yields positive transfer or provable negative transfer.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步提供预测误差的偏差–方差–干扰分解，刻画历史上下文信息何时带来正迁移或可证明的负迁移。

sentences.en: This analysis exposes fundamental limits of attention-based continual inference and offers theoretical explanations for order sensitivity and performance degradation in long prompts.
sentences.zh: 这一分析暴露了基于注意力的持续推理的基本局限，并为长提示中的顺序敏感性与性能退化提供理论解释。

title_en: Understanding Generalization from Embedding Dimension and Distributional Convergence
title_zh: 从嵌入维度与分布收敛理解泛化

sentences.en: Deep neural networks often generalize well despite heavy over-parameterization, challenging classical parameter-based analyses.
sentences.zh: 深层神经网络往往在严重过参数化的情况下仍泛化良好，挑战了经典的基于参数的分析。

sentences.en: We study generalization from a representation-centric perspective and analyze how the geometry of learned embeddings is associated with generalization performance for a fixed trained model.
sentences.zh: 我们从以表示为中心的角度研究泛化，分析习得嵌入的几何如何与固定训练模型的泛化性能相关联。

sentences.en: We derive a post-hoc generalization bound that relates the gap between population risk and held-out empirical risk to two factors:  (i) the intrinsic dimension of the embedding, which determines the convergence rate of the empirical embedding distribution to its population counterpart in Wasserstein distance, and  (ii) the sensitivity of the downstream mapping from embeddings to predictions, characterized by Lipschitz constants.
sentences.zh: 我们推导一个事后泛化界，将总体风险与留出经验风险之间的差距关联到两个因素：（i）嵌入的固有维度，它决定经验嵌入分布在 Wasserstein 距离下向总体对应分布的收敛速率；以及（ii）从嵌入到预测的下游映射的敏感性，由 Lipschitz 常数刻画。

sentences.en: Together, these provide a post-hoc explanation of generalization for trained models.
sentences.zh: 合在一起，这些为训练模型的泛化提供了一种事后的解释。

sentences.en: At the final embedding layer, architectural sensitivity disappears and the bound is dominated by embedding dimension, explaining its strong empirical correlation with generalization performance.
sentences.zh: 在最终嵌入层，架构敏感性消失，界由嵌入维度主导，解释了它与泛化性能的强经验相关性。

sentences.en: Experiments across architectures and datasets validate the theory and demonstrate the utility of embedding-based diagnostics.
sentences.zh: 跨架构与数据集的实验验证了这一理论，并展示了基于嵌入的诊断的实用性。

title_en: Understanding LoRA as Knowledge Memory: An Empirical Analysis
title_zh: 将 LoRA 理解为知识记忆：一项经验分析

sentences.en: Continuous knowledge updating for pre-trained large language models (LLMs) is increasingly necessary yet remains challenging.
sentences.zh: 预训练大语言模型（LLM）的持续知识更新日益必要，但仍具挑战性。

sentences.en: Although inference-time methods like In-Context Learning (ICL) and Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) are popular, they face constraints in context budgets, costs, and retrieval fragmentation.
sentences.zh: 虽然上下文学习（ICL）与检索增强生成（RAG）等推理时方法很流行，它们却面临上下文预算、成本与检索碎片化的约束。

sentences.en: Departing from these context-dependent paradigms, this work investigates a parametric approach using Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) as a modular knowledge memory.
sentences.zh: 脱离这些依赖上下文的范式，这项工作研究一种使用低秩适配（LoRA）作为模块化知识记忆的参数化方法。

sentences.en: Although few recent works examine this concept, the fundamental mechanics governing its capacity and composability remain largely unexplored.
sentences.zh: 虽然近来的少数工作考察了这一概念，但管理其容量与可组合性的基本机制在很大程度上仍未被探索。

sentences.en: We bridge this gap through the first systematic empirical study mapping the design space of LoRA-based memory, ranging from characterizing storage capacity and optimizing internalization to scaling multi-module systems and evaluating long-context reasoning.
sentences.zh: 我们通过首项系统性的经验研究来弥合这一空白，该研究描绘了基于 LoRA 的记忆设计空间，从刻画存储容量、优化内化，到扩展多模块系统与评估长上下文推理。

sentences.en: Rather than proposing a single architecture, we provide practical guidance on the operational boundaries of LoRA memory.
sentences.zh: 我们并不提出单一架构，而是为 LoRA 记忆的操作边界提供实用指导。

sentences.en: Overall, our findings position LoRA as the complementary axis of memory alongside RAG and ICL, offering distinct advantages.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的发现将 LoRA 定位为 RAG 与 ICL 之外互补的记忆轴向，提供独特优势。

title_en: Understanding MARS: When Scaling Momentum Provably Helps
title_zh: 理解 MARS：何时缩放动量可证明地有助

sentences.en: MARS (Yuan et al., 2025) has recently emerged as a strong optimizer for large language model (LLM) training by scaling the correction term in momentum-based variance reduction (MVR).
sentences.zh: MARS（Yuan 等，2025）近年通过缩放基于动量的方差缩减（MVR）中的修正项，成为大语言模型（LLM）训练中的强大优化器。

sentences.en: However, existing theory does not explain why this modification can improve convergence over the unscaled MVR choice $\gamma=1$.
sentences.zh: 然而，现有理论无法解释为何这一修改能在未缩放 MVR 选择 $\gamma=1$ 之上改进收敛。

sentences.en: In this paper, we provide a theoretical explanation for this phenomenon.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们为这一现象提供理论解释。

sentences.en: We introduce **$\gamma$-similarity**, a refined similarity condition that captures how the scaling coefficient interacts with the stochastic gradient-difference structure.
sentences.zh: 我们引入 **$\gamma$-相似性**，一个精细的相似性条件，刻画缩放系数如何与随机梯度差分结构相互作用。

sentences.en: This condition recovers standard similarity at $\gamma=1$ and smoothness at $\gamma=0$.
sentences.zh: 这一条件在 $\gamma=1$ 时恢复标准相似性，在 $\gamma=0$ 时恢复光滑性。

sentences.en: Using $\gamma$-similarity, we derive convergence guarantees for fixed-$\gamma$ MARS whose complexity depends explicitly on $\gamma$ and the corresponding $\gamma$-similarity constant.
sentences.zh: 利用 $\gamma$-相似性，我们推导固定 $\gamma$ MARS 的收敛保证，其复杂度显式依赖 $\gamma$ 与相应的 $\gamma$-相似性常数。

sentences.en: The bound reveals why small values of $\gamma$ can be beneficial: they may reduce the similarity term enough to outweigh the penalty from deviating from MVR.
sentences.zh: 该界揭示为何小的 $\gamma$ 值可能有利：它们可能将相似项降低得足够多，以超过偏离 MVR 的惩罚。

sentences.en: We prove that optimizing $\gamma$ gives MARS a lower complexity guarantee than MVR.
sentences.zh: 我们证明优化 $\gamma$ 使 MARS 获得低于 MVR 的复杂度保证。

sentences.en: Experiments with MARS-AdamW on GPT-style LLM pretraining corroborate the theory, showing that properly chosen small values of $\gamma$ improve token efficiency over $\gamma=1$ and AdamW under a fixed training protocol.
sentences.zh: 在 GPT 风格 LLM 预训练上的 MARS-AdamW 实验证实了这一理论，表明在固定训练协议下，妥善选择的 $\gamma$ 小值相对 $\gamma=1$ 与 AdamW 提升了词元效率。

title_en: Understanding Multimodal Learning: A Loss Landscape Smoothness Perspective
title_zh: 理解多模态学习：损失景观光滑性的视角

sentences.en: A surge of recent advancements has consistently highlighted the superiority of multimodal learning over unimodal approaches across a variety of tasks.
sentences.zh: 近来的一波进展一致强调多模态学习在多种任务上优于单模态方法。

sentences.en: However, the theoretical foundations elucidating this advantage remain underexplored: existing theoretical analyses are often constrained by tight assumptions, and lack empirical validation.
sentences.zh: 然而，阐明这一优势的理论基础仍未得到充分探索：现有理论分析往往受严苛假设约束，且缺乏经验验证。

sentences.en: In this paper, we link this gap by proposing a novel theoretical framework grounded in \textit{convolutional smoothing}, offering a new perspective on how multimodal learning contributes to a smoother loss landscape compared to unimodal learning.
sentences.zh: 在本文中，我们通过提出一个植根于\textit{卷积平滑}的新颖理论框架弥合这一空白，为多模态学习为何比单模态学习带来更光滑的损失景观提供一个新视角。

sentences.en: Building upon this theoretical foundation, we introduce a simple yet effective distributional training approach based on stochastic modality pairing instead of fixed pairing; thus, further promoting flatter landscape via convolutional smoothing.
sentences.zh: 在这一理论基础上，我们引入一个简单而有效的分布训练方法，基于随机模态配对而非固定配对；从而经卷积平滑进一步促进更平坦的景观。

sentences.en: Our empirical results across various multimodal datasets demonstrate that multimodal models not only achieve better performance but also exhibit smoother loss landscape, which represent better robustness and generalization.
sentences.zh: 跨多种多模态数据集的经验结果表明，多模态模型不仅取得更优性能，还展现更光滑的损失景观，这表征了更好的鲁棒性与泛化。

title_en: Understanding Performance Collapse in Layer-Pruned Large Language Models via Decision Representation Transitions
title_zh: 经决策表示转换理解层剪枝大语言模型中的性能崩塌

sentences.en: Layer pruning efficiently reduces Large Language Model (LLM) computational costs but often triggers sudden performance collapse.
sentences.zh: 层剪枝高效降低大语言模型（LLM）计算成本，但往往触发突然的性能崩塌。

sentences.en: Existing representation-based analyses struggle to explain this mechanism.
sentences.zh: 现有的基于表示的分析难以解释这一机制。

sentences.en: We propose studying pruning through decision representation.
sentences.zh: 我们提出通过决策表示研究剪枝。

sentences.en: Focusing on multiple-choice tasks, we introduce two metrics, Decision Margin and Option Frequency, and an Iterative Pruning method to analyze layer-wise decision dynamics.
sentences.zh: 聚焦多项选择任务，我们引入两个指标，决策余量与选项频率，以及一个迭代剪枝方法，以分析逐层决策动态。

sentences.en: Our findings reveal a sharp decision transition that partitions the network into two stages: a Silent Phase, where the model cannot yet predict the correct answer, and a Decisive Phase, where the correct prediction emerges.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现揭示一个将网络划分为两个阶段的锐利决策转换：静默阶段，模型尚不能预测正确答案；以及决断阶段，正确答案涌现。

sentences.en: We also find that pruning the Decisive Phase has minimal impact, whereas pruning the Silent Phase triggers immediate performance collapse, highlighting its extreme sensitivity to structural changes.
sentences.zh: 我们还发现，剪枝决断阶段的影响最小，而剪枝静默阶段会立即触发性能崩塌，凸显其对结构变化的极端敏感性。

sentences.en: Therefore, we conclude that pruning-induced collapse stems from disrupting the Silent Phase, which prevents the critical decision transition from occurring.
sentences.zh: 因此，我们得出结论：剪枝诱导的崩塌源于扰乱静默阶段，这阻止了关键决策转换的发生。

title_en: Understanding Private Learning From Feature Perspective
title_zh: 从特征视角理解私有学习

sentences.en: Differentially private Stochastic Gradient Descent (DP-SGD) has become integral to privacy-preserving machine learning, ensuring robust privacy guarantees in sensitive domains.
sentences.zh: 差分隐私随机梯度下降（DP-SGD）已成为隐私保护机器学习不可或缺的部分，在敏感领域确保强隐私保证。

sentences.en: Despite notable empirical advances leveraging features from non-private, pre-trained models to enhance DP-SGD training, a theoretical understanding of feature dynamics in private learning remains underexplored.
sentences.zh: 尽管利用非私有预训练模型特征来增强 DP-SGD 训练的经验进展显著，对私有学习中特征动力学的理论理解仍未得到充分探索。

sentences.en: This paper presents the first theoretical framework to analyze private training through a feature learning perspective.
sentences.zh: 本文提出首个从特征学习视角分析私有训练的理论框架。

sentences.en: Building on the multi-patch data structure from prior work, our analysis distinguishes between label-dependent feature signals and label-independent noise—a critical aspect overlooked by existing analyses in the DP community.
sentences.zh: 基于先前工作的多块数据结构，我们的分析区分与标签相关的特征信号与与标签无关的噪声——这是 DP 社区现有分析忽视的一个关键方面。

sentences.en: Employing a two-layer CNN with polynomial ReLU activation, we theoretically characterize both feature signal learning and data noise memorization in private training via noisy gradient descent.
sentences.zh: 采用带多项式 ReLU 激活的两层 CNN，我们理论上刻画糟糕的梯度下降进入私有训练中的特征信号学习与数据噪声记忆。

sentences.en: Our findings reveal that (1) Effective private signal learning requires a higher signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) compared to non-private training, and (2) When data noise memorization occurs in non-private learning, it will also occur in private learning, leading to poor generalization despite small training loss.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现揭示：（1）有效的私有信号学习需要比非私有训练更高的信噪比（SNR）；以及（2）当数据噪声记忆发生在非私有学习中时，它也会发生在私有学习中，导致尽管训练损失小却泛化差。

sentences.en: Our findings highlight the challenges of private learning and prove the benefit of feature enhancement to improve SNR.
sentences.zh: 我们的发现凸显私有学习的挑战，并证明特征增强对改进 SNR 的好处。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets also validate our theoretical findings.
sentences.zh: 在合成与真实数据集上的实验也验证了我们的理论发现。

title_en: Understanding Reasoning Collapse in LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
title_zh: 理解 LLM 智能体强化学习中的推理崩塌

sentences.en: In closed-loop multi-turn agent reinforcement learning, LLM agents exhibit reasoning collapse,  where reasoning shift toward generic templates, weakly coupled to the inputs.
sentences.zh: 在闭环多轮智能体强化学习中，LLM 智能体表现出推理崩塌，即推理偏移向与输入弱耦合的通用模板。

sentences.en: We firstly identify that such collapse is easy to miss with entropy or surface diversity metrics since reasoning text still varies but becomes input-agnostic.
sentences.zh: 我们首先识别到，此类崩塌用熵或表面多样性指标很容易被忽视，因为推理文本仍然有变化，但变得与输入无关。

sentences.en: We then propose an information-theoretic decomposition of reasoning variable $Z$'s variation into conditional entropy $H(Z \mid X)$ (randomness under same input) and mutual information (MI) $I(X; Z)$ (input dependence).
sentences.zh: 然后我们提出一个信息论分解，将推理变量 $Z$ 的变化分解为条件熵 $H(Z \mid X)$（相同输入下的随机性）与互信息（MI）$I(X; Z)$（输入依赖）。

sentences.en: Template collapse occurs when $H(Z \mid X)$ stays high while $I(X; Z)$ drops, yielding diverse-looking but generic reasoning.
sentences.zh: 当 $H(Z \mid X)$ 保持较高而 $I(X; Z)$ 下降时出现模板崩塌，产生看似多样但通用的推理。

sentences.en: To make $I(X; Z)$ a reproducible and sanity-checkable diagnostic, we further introduce an MI-style retrieval protocol treating each reasoning trace $Z$ as a query to retrieve its source $X$ from a minibatch; accuracy degrades toward chance under collapse.
sentences.zh: 为使 $I(X; Z)$ 成为可复现且可健全性检查的诊断，我们进一步引入一个 MI 式检索协议，将每条推理轨迹 $Z$ 作为查询，从一个小批次中检索其来源 $X$；在崩塌下准确率朝随机水平退化。

sentences.en: We thus provide a signal-to-noise ratio explanation for why $I(X; Z)$ drops: when within-input reward variance $\mathrm{Var}(R \mid X)$ is low, task gradients weaken and input-agnostic regularizers (KL, entropy) dominate, flattening cross-input differences.
sentences.zh: 我们从而提供一个信噪比解释，说明为何 $I(X; Z)$ 会下降：当输入内奖励方差 $\mathrm{Var}(R \mid X)$ 较低时，任务梯度减弱，与输入无关的正则化器（KL、熵）主导，拉平跨输入差异。

sentences.en: Finally, we propose reward-variance-aware filtering to prioritize high-signal updates.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们提出奖励方差感知过滤，以优先高信号更新。

sentences.en: Across multi-turn environments, model scales, and modalities (including VLMs), this improves input dependence, stability, and performance while remaining competitive with state-of-the-art stabilization baselines.
sentences.zh: 跨多轮环境、模型规模与模态（包括 VLM），这提升了输入依赖、稳定性与性能，同时与最先进的稳定化基线保持竞争力。

title_en: Understanding SAM through Minimax Perspective
title_zh: 从极小极大视角理解 SAM

sentences.en: Sharpness-Aware Minimization (SAM) empirically boosts generalization by seeking parameters that minimize the worst-case loss in a small neighborhood, yet existing theory explains its behavior under either Polyak-Lojasiewicz (PL) condition or upper bounded perturbation radius.
sentences.zh: 锐度感知最小化（SAM）通过寻求使小邻域内最坏情况损失最小化的参数，在经验上提升泛化，但现有理论要么在 Polyak–Lojasiewicz（PL）条件下、要么在上界受限扰动半径下解释其行为。

sentences.en: We revisit SAM through the bilevel minimax problem $\min_{\theta}\max_{\|\Delta\|\le\rho}l(\theta+\Delta)$ and derive a $(\theta,\Delta)$ gradient flow ODE whose equilibria coincide with the problem’s optimality conditions.
sentences.zh: 我们通过二层极小极大问题 $\min_\theta\max_{\|\Delta|\le\rho}l(\theta+Delta)$ 重新审视 SAM，并推导一个平衡点与该问题最优性条件一致的 $(theta, Delta)$ 梯度流 ODE。

sentences.en: A Lyapunov argument-free of convexity assumptions, quantifies how the optimality gap depends on the radius~$\rho$ and local curvature.
sentences.zh: 一个无需凸性假设的 Lyapunov 论证，量化最优性差如何依赖半径~$\rho$ 与局部曲率。

sentences.en: Discretizing the flow yields a \emph{Multi-step SAM} algorithm that recovers classical SAM as $\rho\to 0$.
sentences.zh: 对流的离散化产生一个\emph{多步 SAM}算法，在 $\rho\to 0$ 时恢复经典 SAM。

sentences.en: Moreover, our analysis and the resulting algorithm remain valid even for large $\rho$, providing guidance for aggressive neighborhood exploration.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们的分析与所得算法即使在大 $\rho$ 下仍然有效，为激进的邻域探索提供指导。

sentences.en: Experiments on synthetic objectives and CIFAR-10 validate the predicted gains from multiple inner updates, bridging the gap between SAM’s minimax intuition and its practical implementation.
sentences.zh: 在合成目标与 CIFAR-10 上的实验验证了多次内层更新带来的预测增益，弥合了 SAM 极小极大直觉与其实际实现之间的差距。

title_en: Understanding Self-Supervised Learning via Latent Distribution Matching
title_zh: 经潜在分布匹配理解自监督学习

sentences.en: Self-supervised learning (SSL) excels at finding general-purpose latent representations from complex data, yet lacks a unifying theoretical framework that explains the diverse existing methods and guides the design of new ones.
sentences.zh: 自监督学习（SSL）擅长从复杂数据中发现通用潜在表示，但缺乏一个统一的理论框架来解释多样现有方法并指导新方法的设计。

sentences.en: We cast SSL as latent distribution matching (DM): learning representations that maximize their log-probability under an assumed latent model (alignment), while maximizing latent entropy to prevent collapse (uniformity).
sentences.zh: 我们将 SSL 表述为潜在分布匹配（DM）：学习在假设的潜在模型下最大化其对数概率的表示（对齐），同时最大化潜在熵以防坍缩（均匀性）。

sentences.en: This view unifies independent component analysis with contrastive, non-contrastive, and predictive SSL methods, including stop-gradient approaches.
sentences.zh: 这一视角将独立成分分析与对比、非对比及预测式 SSL 方法（包括停止梯度方法）统一起来。

sentences.en: Leveraging DM, we derive a nonlinear, sampling-free Bayesian filtering model with a Kalman-based predictor for high-dimensional timeseries.
sentences.zh: 利用 DM，我们推导一个非线性、免采样的贝叶斯滤波模型，带基于 Kalman 的预测器，用于高维时间序列。

sentences.en: We further prove that predictive DM yields identifiable latent representations under mild assumptions, even with nonlinear predictors.
sentences.zh: 我们进一步证明，即使带非线性预测器，预测式 DM 在温和假设下也能产生可识别的潜在表示。

sentences.en: Overall, DM clarifies the assumptions behind established SSL methods and provides principled guidance for developing new approaches.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，DM 阐明了既有 SSL 方法背后的假设，并为开发新方法提供了有原则的指导。

title_en: Understanding the Ability of LLMs to Handle Character-Level Perturbation
title_zh: 理解 LLM 处理字符级扰动的能力

sentences.en: This work investigates the resilience of contemporary large language models (LLMs) against frequent character-level perturbations.
sentences.zh: 这项工作研究当代大语言模型（LLM）对常见字符级扰动的韧性。

sentences.en: We examine three types of character-level perturbations including introducing numerous typos within words, shuffling the characters in each word, and inserting a large number of invisible characters into the text.
sentences.zh: 我们考察三类字符级扰动，包括在单词内引入大量拼写错误、打乱每个单词中的字符，以及在文本中插入大量不可见字符。

sentences.en: Surprisingly, even under severe perturbation, such as shuffling nearly all words character-wise to produce text that is almost unreadable to humans, or inserting invisible characters which are several times more than the visible ones as noise, many LLMs still maintain notable performance.
sentences.zh: 令人惊讶的是，即使在严重扰动下（例如逐字符打乱几乎所有单词以产生对人类几乎不可读的文本，或插入比可见字符多出数倍的不可见字符作为噪声），许多 LLM 仍保持显著性能。

sentences.en: We explore the underlying causes of this robustness and find that LLMs exhibit remarkable resilience to chaotic segmentation and fragmented tokenization.
sentences.zh: 我们探索这一鲁棒性的底层原因，发现 LLM 对混沌切分与碎片化词元化表现出非凡韧性。

sentences.en: Furthermore, we examine the mechanisms by which LLMs remove perturbations to correctly comprehend text, including both implicit and explicit mechanisms for character-level perturbation.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们考察 LLM 移除扰动以正确理解文本的机制，包括字符级扰动的隐式与显式机制。

sentences.en: We hope that our findings on the low-level robustness of LLMs will unveil their inherent architectural strengths, reveal the potential risks of their misuse, and inform the reliable deployment of LLMs across diverse application scenarios.
sentences.zh: 我们希望关于 LLM 低级鲁棒性的发现能揭示其固有架构优势，暴露其被滥用的潜在风险，并为 LLM 跨多样应用场景的可靠部署提供信息。

topic: General Machine Learning->Online Learning, Active Learning and Bandits
title_en: Understanding the Gaps in Satisficing Bandits
title_zh: 理解满足型赌博机中的差距

sentences.en: We study a variant of the stochastic multi-armed bandit problem in which the learner aims to identify and play an arbitrary arm whose expected reward exceeds a known satisficing threshold $S$, rather than optimizing against the best arm.
sentences.zh: 我们研究随机多臂赌博机问题的一个变体，其中学习器旨在识别并游玩一个期望奖励超过已知满足阈值 $S$ 的任意臂，而非相对最优臂进行优化。

sentences.en: Prior work has shown that when such a satisficing arm exists, time-independent bounds on the satisficing regret are achievable, but these guarantees deteriorate when an arm lies close to the threshold.
sentences.zh: 先前工作表明，当这样的满足臂存在时，满足遗憾的时间无关界可以实现，但当某臂接近阈值时这些保证会恶化。

sentences.en: We focus on instances in which the excess gap $\Delta_*$ (gap between the best arm and the threshold) is small relative to the suboptimality gaps $\Delta_i$, a regime that exposes this limitation.
sentences.zh: 我们聚焦超额差距 $\Delta_*$（最优臂与阈值之间的差距）相对次优差距 $\Delta_i$ 较小的实例，这一体制暴露了该局限。

sentences.en: To capture this challenge, we introduce a refined notion of regret and propose a new algorithm, uncertain-UCB, which achieves *satisficing* pseudo-regret of $ O \left(\sum_{i: \Delta_i > \Delta_*} \frac{\ln(K/\Delta_*)}{\Delta_i}\right), $ while recovering standard pseudo-regret bounds when no arm exceeds the threshold.
sentences.zh: 为捕捉这一挑战，我们引入一个精炼的遗憾概念，并提出一个新算法 uncertain-UCB，它实现 $ O \left(\sum_{i: \Delta_i > \Delta_*} \frac{\ln(K/\Delta_*)}{\Delta_i}\right), $ 的*满足型*伪遗憾，同时在没有臂超过阈值时恢复标准伪遗憾界。

sentences.en: Further, we establish a near-matching lower bound in the small excess-gap regime, showing that any algorithm incurs at least $ \Omega \left(\sum_{i: \Delta_i > \Delta_*} \frac{\ln  \big(\frac{\Delta}{(K-1) \Delta_* }\big)}{\Delta_i}\right) $ satisficing pseudo-regret.
sentences.zh: 此外，我们在小超额差距体制下确立一个近乎匹配的下界，表明任何算法至少招致 $ \Omega \left(\sum_{i: \Delta_i > \Delta_*} \frac{\ln  \big(\frac{\Delta}{(K-1) \Delta_* }\big)}{\Delta_i}\right) $ 的满足型伪遗憾。

title_en: Understanding the Parameter Space Geometry of Transformers Encoding Boolean Functions
title_zh: 理解编码布尔函数的 Transformer 参数空间几何

sentences.en: Transformers consistently fail to learn certain simple functions that are provably expressible with specific parameter settings.
sentences.zh: Transformer 一致地无法学习某些被证明能用特定参数设置表达的简单函数。

sentences.en: This gap between *learnability* and *expressivity* is particularly prominent for sensitive functions---functions whose output is likely to change if a single bit of the input is flipped---for example, Parity.
sentences.zh: *可学习性*与*表达力*之间的这一差距在敏感函数上尤为突出——即如果输入中的单个比特被翻转其输出很可能变化的函数——例如 Parity。

sentences.en: While prior work has established that transformers exhibit a bias toward functions with low average sensitivity, the precise mechanism underlying this bias remains poorly understood.
sentences.zh: 虽然先前工作已确立 Transformer 展现出对低平均敏感度函数的偏爱，但这一偏爱背后的精确机制仍未得到很好理解。

sentences.en: To shed light on this phenomenon, we study the geometry of transformers' parameter space.
sentences.zh: 为阐明这一现象，我们研究 Transformer 参数空间的几何。

sentences.en: We show that sensitive functions---even when representable---occupy a vanishingly small region that random initialization is very likely to miss.
sentences.zh: 我们表明敏感函数——即使可表示——也只占据一个随机初始化极可能错过的消逝般小的区域。

sentences.en: Specifically, we shift the focus from average sensitivity to the full sensitivity profile---the distribution of sensitivity values across all inputs---and prove that randomly initialized transformers almost surely compute functions which have low-sensitivity strings.
sentences.zh: 具体地，我们将焦点从平均敏感度转向完整敏感度分布——所有输入上敏感度值的分布——并证明随机初始化的 Transformer 几乎必然计算具有低敏感度字符串的函数。

sentences.en: Consequently, any function that lacks such strings is provably unlearnable.
sentences.zh: 因此，任何缺乏这类字符串的函数都是可证明不可学习的。

title_en: Understanding the Performance Gap in Preference Learning: A Dichotomy of RLHF and DPO
title_zh: 理解偏好学习中的性能差距：RLHF 与 DPO 的二分法

sentences.en: We present a fine-grained theoretical analysis of the performance gap between two-stage reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF) and direct preference optimization (DPO).
sentences.zh: 我们对两阶段基于人类反馈的强化学习（RLHF）与直接偏好优化（DPO）之间的性能差距进行细粒度理论分析。

sentences.en: Our study decomposes this gap into two sources: the explicit representation gap under exact optimization and the implicit representation gap under finite samples.
sentences.zh: 我们的研究将这一差距分解为两个来源：精确优化下的显式表示差距与有限样本下的隐式表示差距。

sentences.en: In the exact optimization setting, we characterize how the relative capacities of the reward and policy model classes influence the final policy qualities.
sentences.zh: 在精确优化设定中，我们刻画奖励与策略模型类别的相对容量如何影响最终策略质量。

sentences.en: We show that RLHF, DPO, or online DPO can outperform one another depending on type of model mis-specifications.
sentences.zh: 我们表明，取决于模型错配类型，RLHF、DPO 或在线 DPO 可以相互超越。

sentences.en: Notably, online DPO can outperform both RLHF and standard DPO when the reward and policy model classes are isomorphic and both mis-specified.
sentences.zh: 值得注意的是，当奖励与策略模型类别同构且都被错配时，在线 DPO 可以同时超越 RLHF 与标准 DPO。

sentences.en: In the approximate optimization setting, we provide a concrete construction where the ground-truth reward is sparse and show that RLHF requires significantly fewer samples than DPO to recover an effective reward model, highlighting a statistical advantage of two-stage learning.
sentences.zh: 在近似优化设定中，我们提供一个真值奖励稀疏的具体构造，并表明 RLHF 恢复有效奖励模型所需样本显著少于 DPO，凸显两阶段学习的统计优势。

sentences.en: Together, these results provide a comprehensive understanding of the performance gap between RLHF and DPO under various settings, and offer practical insights into when each method is preferred.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，这些结果对 RLHF 与 DPO 在多种设定下的性能差距提供了全面理解，并揭示了何时应偏好每种方法的实用洞见。

topic: General Machine Learning->Transfer, Multitask and Meta-learning
title_en: Understanding Transfer Learning of RNA Foundation Models on Downstream Tasks
title_zh: 理解 RNA 基础模型在下游任务上的迁移学习

sentences.en: Foundation models (FMs) pretrained on large-scale sequence data have emerged as a promising paradigm for RNA biology, yet the mechanisms underlying their transferability remain unclear.
sentences.zh: 在大规模序列数据上预训练的基础模型（FM）已成为 RNA 生物学中有前景的范式，但其可迁移性背后的机制仍不清楚。

sentences.en: In this work, we conduct a systematic investigation of transfer learning in RNA FMs across diverse structural and functional tasks.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们对 RNA FM 在多样结构与功能任务上的迁移学习进行系统性研究。

sentences.en: Our results demonstrate that frozen representations from pretrained RNA FMs are not universally transferable, and that the hierarchical feature reuse paradigm prevalent in computer vision does not generally extend to RNA FMs.
sentences.zh: 我们的结果表明，预训练 RNA FM 的冻结表示并非普遍可迁移，且计算机视觉中盛行的层级特征复用范式通常不延伸到 RNA FM。

sentences.en: Instead, pretraining primarily benefits downstream tasks by providing a favorable optimization initialization when pretraining and downstream objectives are well aligned, which accelerates convergence toward flatter minima associated with improved generalization.
sentences.zh: 相反，当预训练与下游目标良好对齐时，预训练主要通过提供有利的优化初始化来惠及下游任务，这加速了向与改进泛化相关的更平坦极小的收敛。

sentences.en: Overall, our findings characterize pretraining as an optimization prior whose effectiveness is governed by task alignment and model capacity, offering principled guidance for future RNA FMs.
sentences.zh: 总体而言，我们的发现将预训练刻画为一个优化先验，其有效性受任务对齐与模型容量支配，为未来的 RNA FM 提供有原则的指导。

authors.name: Ke Li
authors.institution: Living Systems Institute, University of Exeter

title_en: Understanding Truncated Positional Encodings for Graph Neural Networks
title_zh: 理解图神经网络的截断位置编码

sentences.en: Positional encodings (PEs) enhance the power of graph neural networks (GNNs), both theoretically and empirically.
sentences.zh: 位置编码（PE）在理论与经验两方面增强图神经网络（GNN）的能力。

sentences.en: Two of the most popular families of PEs---spectral (e.g., Laplacian eigenspaces, effective resistance) and random walk (polynomials of the adjacency matrix)---are theoretically equivalent in expressive power, and both are known to lie between the 1-WL and 3-WL tests in terms of expressivity.
sentences.zh: 谱（例如 Laplacian 特征空间、有效电阻）与随机游走（邻接矩阵的多项式）这两个最流行的 PE 家族在表达力上理论等价，且两者都已知在表达力上介于 1-WL 与 3-WL 测试之间。

sentences.en: However, this equivalence assumes the GNN uses the "complete'' version of these PEs, which requires $O(n^3)$ time and space complexity.
sentences.zh: 然而，这一等价假设 GNN 使用这些 PE 的“完整”版本，这需要 $O(n^3)$ 的时间与空间复杂度。

sentences.en: Practitioners therefore commonly use truncated variants of these encodings (e.g., the first $k$ eigenspaces or powers of adjacency matrix).
sentences.zh: 因此从业者通常使用这些编码的截断变体（例如前 $k$ 个特征空间或邻接矩阵的幂）。

sentences.en: However, the theoretical properties of these truncated PEs are unknown.
sentences.zh: 然而，这些截断 PE 的理论性质未知。

sentences.en: In this work, we initiate the study of these truncated PEs.
sentences.zh: 在这项工作中，我们开启对截断 PE 的研究。

sentences.en: Theoretically, we show that, under truncation, several families of PEs are fundamentally different in expressive power.
sentences.zh: 在理论上，我们表明，在截断下，几个 PE 家族在表达力上根本不同。

sentences.en: As a corollary, we show that truncated spectral PEs are no longer stronger than the 1-WL test.
sentences.zh: 作为推论，我们表明截断的谱 PE 不再强于 1-WL 测试。

sentences.en: We also study a family of spectral PEs, the $k$-harmonic distances, to highlight the differences in expressive power of even closely related truncated PEs.
sentences.zh: 我们还研究一族谱 PE——$k$-谐波距离——以凸显即便是密切相关的截断 PE 在表达力上的差异。

sentences.en: Finally, we experimentally show that a mix of truncated PEs is preferable to any single family on real-world datasets.
sentences.zh: 最后，我们在实验上表明，在真实世界数据集上，混合的截断 PE 优于任何单一家族。

topic: General Machine Learning->Sequential, Network, and Time Series Modeling
title_en: Unfolded Laplacian Spectral Embedding: A Theoretically Grounded Approach to Dynamic Network Representation
title_zh: 展开 Laplacian 谱嵌入：面向动态网络表示的理论性方法

sentences.en: Dynamic relational data arise in many machine learning applications, yet their evolving structure poses challenges for learning representations that remain consistent and interpretable over time.
sentences.zh: 动态关系数据出现在许多机器学习应用中，但其演化结构为学习随时间保持一致且可解释的表示带来挑战。

sentences.en: A common approach is to learn time varying node embeddings, whose usefulness depends on well defined stability properties across nodes and across time.
sentences.zh: 一种常见方法是学习时变节点嵌入，其有用性取决于跨节点与跨时间定义良好的稳定性性质。

sentences.en: We introduce Unfolded Laplacian Spectral Embedding (ULSE), a principled extension of unfolded adjacency spectral embedding to normalized Laplacian operators, a setting where stability guarantees have remained out of reach.
sentences.zh: 我们引入展开 Laplacian 谱嵌入（ULSE），将展开邻接谱嵌入有原则地扩展到归一化 Laplacian 算子，这是一个稳定性保证一直难以企及的设定。

sentences.en: We prove that ULSE satisfies both cross-sectional and longitudinal stability under a dynamic stochastic block model.
sentences.zh: 我们证明 ULSE 在动态随机块模型下同时满足横截面与纵向稳定性。

sentences.en: Moreover, the Laplacian formulation yields a dynamic Cheeger-type inequality linking the spectrum of the unfolded normalized Laplacian to worst case conductance over time, providing structural insight into the embeddings.
sentences.zh: 此外，Laplacian 表述产生一个动态 Cheeger 式不等式，将展开归一化 Laplacian 的谱与随时间的最坏情况电导联系起来，为嵌入提供结构洞见。

sentences.en: Empirical results on synthetic and real-world dynamic networks validate the theory.
sentences.zh: 在合成与真实世界动态网络上的经验结果验证了这一理论。

title_en: Unfolding Generative Flows with Koopman Operators: Trajectory-Preserving Linearization
title_zh: 用 Koopman 算子展开生成流：保持轨迹的线性化

sentences.en: Continuous Normalizing Flows (CNFs) enable elegant generative modeling but remain bottlenecked by their iterative nature requiring costly sampling and lacking interpretability of the intermediate states.
sentences.zh: 连续归一化流（CNF）实现优雅的生成建模，但仍受其迭代性质（需要昂贵采样且缺乏中间状态可解释性）的瓶颈制约。

sentences.en: Recent approaches accelerate sampling by straightening trajectories or distilling endpoints, yet they treat the original generative process as a black box, discarding the teacher’s intermediate dynamics.
sentences.zh: 近来方法通过拉直轨迹或蒸馏端点加速采样，却将原始生成过程视为黑盒，丢弃教师的中间动力学。

sentences.en: We propose a fundamentally different perspective: globally linearizing flow dynamics via Koopman theory to achieve trajectory-preserving linearization.
sentences.zh: 我们提出一个根本不同的视角：经 Koopman 理论全局线性化流动力学，实现保持轨迹的线性化。

sentences.en: By lifting Conditional Flow Matching (CFM) into a higher-dimensional Koopman space, we represent its evolution with a single linear operator.
sentences.zh: 通过将条件流匹配（CFM）提升到更高维的 Koopman 空间，我们用一个单一线性算子表示其演化。

sentences.en: Crucially, unlike boundary-only distillation, our method enforces infinitesimal consistency with the teacher's vector field along *the full generative path*.
sentences.zh: 关键在于，与仅边界的蒸馏不同，我们的方法沿*完整生成路径*强制与教师向量场的无穷小一致性。

sentences.en: We derive a practical, simulation-free training objective that ensures this global alignment and yields two key benefits.
sentences.zh: 我们推导一个实用、免模拟的训练目标，确保这种全局对齐，并带来两个关键好处。

sentences.en: First, sampling becomes one-step and parallelizable.
sentences.zh: 首先，采样变为单步且可并行化的。

sentences.en: Second, because the linearization is faithful to the dynamics, the Koopman operator provides unique insights on the generation.
sentences.zh: 其次，由于线性化忠实于动力学，Koopman 算子为生成提供独特洞见。

sentences.en: We demonstrate that this structure enables novel applications unavailable in prior approaches, including discovery of semantically coherent editing directions, inversion with a teacher-aligned linear operator and class-conditional spectral signatures.
sentences.zh: 我们证明这一结构使能的、先前方法无法提供的应用，包括发现语义一致的编辑方向、用教师对齐线性算子求逆，以及类条件谱签名。

sentences.en: Empirically, our approach achieves competitive sample quality, while enabling spectral analysis and control of the *entire trajectories* of generative flows.
sentences.zh: 在经验上，我们的方法取得有竞争力的样本质量，同时实现对生成流*整条轨迹*的谱分析与控制。

title_en: UnHype: CLIP-Guided Hypernetworks for Dynamic LoRA Unlearning
title_zh: UnHype：基于CLIP引导的超网络实现动态LoRA遗忘

sentences.en: Recent advances in large-scale diffusion models have intensified concerns about their potential misuse, particularly in generating realistic yet harmful or socially disruptive content.
sentences.zh: 大规模扩散模型的最新进展加剧了人们对其潜在滥用的担忧，尤其是在生成逼真但有害或具有社会破坏性内容方面。

sentences.en: This challenge has spurred growing interest in effective machine unlearning, the process of selectively removing specific knowledge or concepts from a model without compromising its overall generative capabilities.
sentences.zh: 这一挑战激发了人们对高效机器遗忘日益浓厚的兴趣；机器遗忘是指在不损害模型整体生成能力的前提下，选择性移除模型中特定知识或概念的过程。

sentences.en: Among various approaches, Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) has emerged as an effective and efficient method for fine-tuning models toward targeted unlearning.
sentences.zh: 在各种方法中，低秩适配（LoRA）已成为针对目标遗忘对模型进行微调的一种有效且高效的方法。

sentences.en: However, LoRA-based methods often exhibit limited adaptability to concept semantics and struggle to balance removing closely related concepts with maintaining generalization across broader meanings.
sentences.zh: 然而，基于LoRA的方法通常对概念语义的适配能力有限，并且难以在移除紧密相关概念与保持更广泛语义上的泛化能力之间取得平衡。

sentences.en: Moreover, these methods face scalability challenges when multiple concepts must be erased simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 此外，当需要同时擦除多个概念时，这些方法还面临可扩展性方面的挑战。

sentences.en: To address these limitations, we introduce UnHype, a framework that incorporates hypernetworks into single- and multi-concept LoRA training.
sentences.zh: 为解决这些局限，我们提出了UnHype，一个将超网络融入单概念与多概念LoRA训练的框架。

sentences.en: The proposed architecture can be directly plugged into Stable Diffusion as well as modern flow-based text-to-image models, where it demonstrates stable training behavior and effective concept control.
sentences.zh: 所提出的架构可以直接嵌入Stable Diffusion以及现代的基于流的文生图模型中，在这些模型中它展现出稳定的训练行为和有效的概念控制能力。

sentences.en: During inference, the hypernetwork dynamically generates adaptive LoRA weights based on the CLIP embedding, enabling more context-aware, scalable unlearning.
sentences.zh: 在推理过程中，超网络根据CLIP嵌入动态生成自适应的LoRA权重，从而实现更具上下文感知性、可扩展的机器遗忘。

sentences.en: We evaluate UnHype across several challenging tasks, including object erasure, celebrity erasure, and explicit content removal, demonstrating its effectiveness and versatility.
sentences.zh: 我们在多个具有挑战性的任务上对UnHype进行了评估，包括物体擦除、名人擦除和露骨内容移除，验证了其有效性与通用性。
